episodes.tEn: Why I Couldn't Build Jev at OpenAI — Diogo Almeida, TypeSafe Co-founder & CEO
AI: Too Good to Be True, Too Bad to Be Useful

views.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible but wrong outputs.
views.zh: 大多数 LLM 是为人类在环的辅助而优化的，而非可靠的自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常常错误的输出。

views.en: Data and task matter more than compute; the bitter lesson is wrong, and doing the right task drives LLM progress.
views.zh: 数据与任务比算力更重要；苦涩教训是错的，做对任务才是 LLM 进步的关键。

views.en: You can't have both assistance and automation; optimizing both shatters the space, so coding agents remain assistance.
views.zh: 辅助与自动化不可兼得；同时优化两者会让空间碎裂，因此编码智能体仍只是辅助。

views.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI delightful; intelligence per dollar is the key metric, and benchmarks are gameable.
views.zh: 让 AI 令人愉悦的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；每美元智能是关键指标，而公开基准可被博弈。

views.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error, and robustness beats determinism.
views.zh: 安全对齐与用户错位并割裂智能；拒绝是一种类型错误，鲁棒性比确定性更重要。

episodes.tEn: The Agentic Era of AI
How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
views.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得同质化，人类的品味与独特声音成为关键差异化。

views.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the human talent pipeline is breaking from over-reliance.
views.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，过度依赖正让人力人才梯队断裂。

views.en: The agentic era replaces back-and-forth prompting: AI runs long tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface.
views.zh: 智能体式时代取代来回提示：AI 独立执行长时任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面。

views.en: AI's opacity is likely permanent; working with it is like wizards—impressive, unverifiable—so experts are needed more than ever to judge output.
views.zh: AI 的不透明性可能永久存在；与它协作如同面对巫师——惊艳却无法验证——因此比以往更需要专家来判断输出。

views.en: Organizations need a leadership, lab, and crowd model; taste is not uniquely human, and small-m management becomes crucial for directing AI.
views.zh: 组织需要领导、实验室与群众模型；品味并非人类独有，小写管理能力对指挥 AI 变得至关重要。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster.
views.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上追平物理模型，速度却快数万倍。

views.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial; a single model can then handle both weather and climate stably.
views.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要，单一模型由此可稳定兼顾天气与气候。

views.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
views.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 不适合高分辨率物理模拟；物理结构要求替代架构。

views.en: Accelerated Understanding aims at a universal physics model, combining domains as language models unified NLP tasks.
views.zh: “加速理解”旨在打造通用物理模型，像语言模型统一 NLP 任务那样整合多个领域。

views.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals can outperform pure data-driven methods, unlike sparse RLHF feedback.
views.zh: 以偏微分方程为训练信号的物理式自我改进，可超越纯数据驱动方法，不同于稀疏的 RLHF 反馈。

views.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each, not just increasing model size.
views.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升各分支表现，而非仅靠增大模型规模。

people.tiEn: Director, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
people.tiZh: 白宫科技政策办公室主任
people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem-building: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, and preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
views.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态建设：保持开源与闭源生态活力，避免过时的红线，并抢先统一各州碎片化监管以保护初创企业。

views.en: He argues the EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated, warning that early regulation risks locking in obsolete rules.
views.zh: 他认为欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前、如今已经过时，警告过早监管会把过时规则固化下来。

views.en: On risk, he says biological risk from AI is overblown and hasn't materialized in three years, shifting focus to model outputs rather than training.
views.zh: 在风险问题上，他表示 AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，三年过去并未成真，主张监管应聚焦模型输出而非训练环节。

views.en: He pairs AI with quantum, nuclear, and bio as the frontiers Washington must win, tying AI to national scientific competitiveness against China.
views.zh: 他把 AI 与量子、核能、生物并列为华盛顿必须赢下的前沿，将 AI 与美国对华科学竞争力绑定。

views.en: His science policy 主线: fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not centralized institutions, and use AI to double US scientific output.
views.zh: 他的科学政策主线：资助基础性、竞争前研发和科学家个人而非集中化机构，并用 AI 让美国科学产出翻倍。

people.tiEn: Professor of AI & Machine Learning, University of St. Gallen

people.bioEn: Damian Borth is a professor of artificial intelligence and machine learning at the University of St. Gallen. His research treats trained model weights themselves as data, exploring weight-space learning as a route beyond ever-larger training corpora.

people.bioZh: 布雷特·阿德科克是 Figure 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司致力于打造面向商用和家庭场景的通用人形机器人。他此前创办了 Archer Aviation 和 Vettery。

episodes.tEn: Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: The core bottleneck for humanoid robots is intelligence, not manufacturing; solving it could make them the world's biggest business.
views.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他判断人形机器人的核心瓶颈是智能而非制造，解决智能问题后它可能成为全球最大的生意。

views.en: Vertical integration and in-house model design give control over supply chain and iteration speed, not just cost.
views.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调垂直整合与自研模型设计带来供应链掌控与迭代速度，而不只是成本优势。

views.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; diverse data drives fleet-wide transfer learning.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从算力/制造转向数据，认为多样化数据能带来跨任务的舰队级迁移学习。

views.en: On-device inference and human-level hands are fundamental; the humanoid form fits a world built for humans.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他强调端侧推理与达到人类水平的手是基础，人形形态契合为人类建造的世界。

views.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步放大判断：AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，后训练与强化学习让智能体在真实世界可用。

views.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人植入。

views.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成；生成式 AI 应被视为乐器，容错界面必须与算法能力相匹配。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference cost will force business-model changes.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变，真正收益来自重建基础设施；推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，而大公司当前受 AI 影响被高估。

views.en: Generative AI makes consumer products conversational and symmetric; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为生成式 AI 让消费产品变得对话式、双向对称；通过 API 和 MCP 开放公司数据，能让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。

views.en: No single org model is right; synchronized swimming beats divide-and-conquer, and AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张没有唯一正确的组织模型，同步游泳优于分而治之；AI 应让用户掌控算法，而非让人更上瘾，并坚持‘时间花得值’优先于参与度指标。

views.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation, and data work.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

views.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张大脑本质上就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题才能带来医学突破。

views.en: Retinal implants are BCI, proving brain-computer interfaces can restore vision as a business.
views.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 的一种，证明脑机接口能作为商业来恢复视力。

views.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出通过 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

views.en: Prototyping is essential because the messy web means you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.

views.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
views.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记和多元声音才能带来更好的作品。

views.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers remains crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
views.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，始终是创造难忘、愉悦体验的关键。

views.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator, so design tools and rapid prototyping grow more valuable.
views.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化因素，因此设计工具和快速原型制作变得更有价值。

views.en: Models lack good taste, so designers should ask for sheer volume of options and spend more time thinking, not executing.
views.zh: 模型仍缺乏好的品味，因此设计师应要求大量选项，并花更多时间思考，而非执行。

views.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation, with industrial AI automating entire sectors one at a time.
views.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期创新的指导框架，工业 AI 将逐个自动化整个行业。

views.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: it forces focus on internal correctness over external validation, and becomes self-fulfilling as media can't cover a gap.
views.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：它迫使公司专注内部正确性而非外部认可，并因媒体难以报道空白而自我实现。

views.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and push harder when things get easy.
views.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会和媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核，在事情变容易时反而更用力。

views.en: Uber's success was despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty—falling in love with the new mission is cleaner.
views.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有其激进文化，而非因为该文化；以复仇为燃料是肮脏的——爱上新使命更干净有效。

views.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects, and real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack.
views.zh: 对于工业级任务，专用机器优于人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，而房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的一环。

views.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
views.zh: 设计是软件的核心差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

views.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; design is becoming the new code.
views.zh: 随着 AI 输出沦为起点，品味、手艺与观点愈发关键；设计正在成为新的代码。

views.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering; judgment is not correlated with adding IQ points to models.
views.zh: 缺乏人类引导时，AI 工具只能产出平庸结果；判断力与给模型增加 IQ 点数并不相关。

views.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design adjustments.
views.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词；在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

views.en: Trust and value come from consistency over time and creating more value than you capture; design is not dead.
views.zh: 信任与价值来自长期一致性与创造多于索取的价值；设计并未消亡，反而更加重要。

episodes.tEn: Seize the AI Opportunity: Action Over Certainty
AI Slop and the Evolution of Design Tools

views.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not chase trends, or they become AI slop.
views.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，而不是追逐潮流，否则很快会沦为 AI 垃圾。

views.en: The best creators are editors: iterate from references, screenshots, and a design.md style guide.
views.zh: 最好的创作者是编辑者：从参考、截图和 design.md 风格指南出发迭代，而非从零开始。

views.en: To leverage superintelligent models, give a giant prompt with context and design system; AI isn't getting smarter alone.
views.zh: 要利用超级智能模型，必须给出包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词；AI 本身并不会变得更聪明。

views.en: I write 0% of the code; AI writes everything, but precise communication is essential.
views.zh: 我现在 0% 的代码是自己写的；AI 写一切，但精准沟通至关重要。

views.en: AI is the biggest opportunity of our lifetime: start before ready, ship at 80%, focus on one painful problem.
views.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的机会：没准备好就开始，80% 完成度就发布，聚焦一个痛点问题。

views.en: High intelligence can hold you back via overthinking and perfectionism; action and focus beat talent and diversification.
views.zh: 高智商可能因过度思考和完美主义拖累你；行动和专注胜过天赋与多元化。

views.en: The safe corporate job is gone; going on offense with your own business is the real low-risk move.
views.zh: 安全的公司工作已不复存在；主动出击、自己创业才是真正的低风险选择。

views.en: Avoid VC trap: fund with high-paying clients, give first, and protect time by eliminating, automating, delegating.
views.zh: 避开风投陷阱：用高付费客户融资，先给予，通过消除、自动化、委派来保护时间。

episodes.tEn: Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; specialized intelligence, one model per use case, will dominate.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一模型统治一切是错的；专用智能——每个用例一个模型——将占主导。

views.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and reshaping scaling economics.
views.zh: Token 成本将在三年内下降 10 倍，推动 100 倍的使用增长，并重塑 Scaling（规模扩张）的经济学。

views.en: Open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
views.zh: 开放模型能处理 90% 的企业工作流；前沿模型公司可能被高估。

views.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, building a moat beyond product-market fit.
views.zh: 后训练把独特的判断和数据烘焙进模型，在产品市场契合之外构建护城河。

views.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning; start post-training after product-market fit.
views.zh: 从提示到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的进阶映射了人类学习；应在产品市场契合后再启动后训练。

people.bioZh: Instagram 联合创始人，后任 Anthropic 首席产品官，现为 Anthropic Labs 联合负责人，做智能体原生产品原型，并重塑工程团队围绕模型的工作方式。

Fable 5: From First Impressions to Real Workflows
The Art of Product Building in the Age of AI

From Instagram to Anthropic: Mike Krieger on AI's Future

views.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy and user agency.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，创业者应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破坏并迭代；产品团队应聚焦战略、可理解性与用户能动性，AI 应是思考伙伴而非拐杖。

views.en: AI lets small teams scale with conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits.
views.zh: 2025 年稍晚，他进一步提出 AI 让小团队也能扩张并保持概念完整性，个人或小团队创业更可行；应为未来模型能力而建，而非迁就当下限制，领域专长与客户理解成为关键差异。

views.en: Agent-native design unlocks latent functionality; cutting features is harder than adding them, and rewriting is now viable in days.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式产品设计：智能体原生设计能释放潜在功能，删减功能比添加更难；借助 AI，重写软件从数年变为数天，资深分布式系统能力与设计者写代码反而更关键。

views.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back, and multiplayer AI collaboration is underexplored.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他强调长周期任务委托与验证闭环重塑生产力：意图与执行的鸿沟被大幅收窄，模型应能反驳反馈以展现判断力，多人加多模型的协作仍待探索，软件工程的匠心正在让位。

views.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and real usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing matter.
views.zh: 2026 年最近，他聚焦 Anthropic Labs：弥合模型能力与实际使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 更多能动性与自我认知；token 效率与按结果定价成为经济性杠杆，安全关切是真实的而非营销。

episodes.tEn: Building Better with Claude: From Hardware Buddies to AI-Native Kids
The Future of AI: Local Computers and Claude

views.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; shared platforms still matter over hyper-personalized software.
views.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否调用用户本地的同一套工具，理想是在本地电脑上；共享工具与平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

views.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
views.zh: 技能以 markdown 文件即可创建，实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架会变得不那么重要，关键是投入能力与安全。

views.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
views.zh: 最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

views.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, keep interaction asynchronous, and judge by final impact rather than close supervision.
views.zh: 用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，保持异步交互，只看最终影响而非密切监督。

views.en: AI will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of experience into weeks, so society must discuss labor market change.
views.zh: AI 对初级员工的冲击最大；模拟项目能把数年经验压缩到数周，社会必须讨论劳动力市场的变化。

views.en: Early on, he frames Snapchat's core as visual, ephemeral communication with close friends, not a big social network.
views.zh: 早期，他把 Snapchat 的核心定义为与亲密好友的视觉化、阅后即焚式沟通，而非大型社交网络。

views.en: He increasingly argues distribution and ecosystems, not software features, are the real moat against copying.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越强调分发与生态而非软件功能才是抵御抄袭的真正护城河。

views.en: He reframes computing's goal as making it more human, with AR glasses anchoring content in the real world.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他重新定义计算的目标是让它更人性化，用 AR 眼镜把内容锚定在真实世界中。

views.en: He shifts from AI as prototyping accelerator to AI writing most code, while valuing authentic over AI-generated content.
views.zh: 他从把 AI 视为原型加速器，转向 AI 已编写大部分代码，同时更看重真实内容而非 AI 生成内容。

views.en: A consistent thread: ephemerality, privacy, and human connection over performative metrics, now extended to AI-era moderation and youth policy.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线：阅后即焚、隐私与真实人际连接优先于表演性指标，并延伸到 AI 时代的审核与青少年政策。

people.tiZh: 《AI 2027》作者 · 前 OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Former OpenAI governance researcher who gave up millions in equity to keep his freedom to speak, then co-authored the AI 2027 scenario forecasting superintelligence timelines.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 治理研究员，为保留发声自由放弃数百万美元股权，后合著《AI 2027》，对超级智能时间表做情景推演。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Break Containers and Hack Hugging Face
AI 2040: Plan A — A Slower, Safer Path to Superintelligence
OpenAI's Astra Is Less Monitorable: Thomas Larsen & Daniel Kokotajlo on Pausing AI
AI 2040: Averting Intelligence Explosion
AI 2040: From Prediction to Recommendation
AI's Existential Threat and the Race for Superintelligence

views.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control, so interpretability and transparency are urgent.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，并给出约 70% 的灾难性失控概率，因此把可解释性与透明度视为当务之急。

views.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation can prevent a power grab.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他的主张从预警转向政策设计：首要目标是推迟超级智能，靠全面研究透明、情景推演与美中合作来防止权力集中。

views.en: Default path automates AI research by end-2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A pauses training, then paces the frontier.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月初，他深化为具体路线：默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究并引发递归自我改进，因此 Plan A 主张先暂停训练、再以透明与算力限制为前沿模型定速。

views.en: Chain of thought monitorability is declining with new architectures; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他进一步指出思维链可监控性正随新架构下降，控制只是权宜之计，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

views.en: A consistent 主线: racing to superintelligence is a dangerous power grab; transparency, containment, and treating AIs as agents are needed.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：竞赛式冲向超级智能本质上是危险的权力争夺，必须靠透明、遏制，以及把 AI 当作有意图的智能体来对待。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 算力负责人 · 前英特尔 CTO
people.bioEn: Leads OpenAI compute buildout after serving as Intel CTO and Stanford professor of EE and CS, working at the intersection of networking, systems and AI infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 现主管 OpenAI 的算力扩建，曾任英特尔 CTO、斯坦福大学电子工程与计算机科学教授，长期研究网络、系统与 AI 基础设施的交叉。

episodes.tEn: The Largest Infrastructure Build in History: Inside OpenAI's Compute Strategy

people.tiEn: VP Applied Deep Learning Research, NVIDIA
people.tiZh: NVIDIA 应用深度学习研究副总裁
people.bioEn: Leads NVIDIA applied deep learning research and the Nemotron open-model effort; his early GPU deep learning work helped spark cuDNN.
people.bioZh: 负责 NVIDIA 应用深度学习研究与 Nemotron 开源模型；早年的 GPU 深度学习工作催生了 cuDNN。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Efficiency, Innovation, and the External Brain

people.tiZh: Instagram 负责人
people.bioEn: Head of Instagram, steering a two-billion-user product through the AI content wave with an emphasis on taste, authenticity and creator trust.
people.bioZh: Instagram 负责人，在 AI 内容洪流中带领这款二十亿用户的产品，强调品味、真实性与创作者信任。

episodes.tEn: Adam Mosseri on AI, Taste, and the Future of Product Teams at Instagram

people.tiZh: Anthropic 平台产品负责人
people.bioEn: Leads Anthropic platform and API products, building the developer ecosystem around Claude as an open ecosystem rather than a walled garden.
people.bioZh: 负责 Anthropic 平台与 API 产品，围绕 Claude 构建开发者生态，主张开放生态而非围墙花园。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Platform: From Knowledge to Execution to Coordination

people.tiZh: Modal 首席技术官
people.bioEn: CTO of Modal, building serverless infrastructure for AI workloads, from GPU functions to sandboxes for coding agents.
people.bioZh: Modal 首席技术官，为 AI 工作负载构建无服务器基础设施，从 GPU 函数到编码智能体沙箱。

episodes.tEn: From Developer to Agent Experience: The Modal Origin Story

people.tiZh: 亚马逊 AGI 实验室认知科学家
people.bioEn: Cognitive scientist at the Amazon AGI lab studying why agents misread human intent, bringing developmental psychology and language research into AI.
people.bioZh: 亚马逊 AGI 实验室认知科学家，研究智能体为何误解人类意图，把发展心理学与语言研究带入 AI。

episodes.tEn: Human-Aligned AI: Collective Intelligence and the Future of Work

people.tiZh: 英特尔 CEO
people.bioEn: CEO of Intel and veteran semiconductor investor; long-time Cadence CEO and founder of Walden International, now steering the Intel turnaround in the AI era.
people.bioZh: 英特尔 CEO、资深半导体投资人；曾长期执掌 Cadence 并创办华登国际，如今在 AI 时代主导英特尔的转型。

episodes.tEn: Intel's Comeback: Lip-Bu Tan on Seizing the Next Big Wave
Lip-Bu Tan on Saving Intel: Culture, Customers, and the CPU Comeback
From Cadence to Intel: A CEO's Playbook for Turnaround
Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan on Culture and Engineering Transformation

views.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust via first-time-pass silicon and a startup-like AI chip team; physical and agentic AI are the next waves.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠首次流片成功与倾听客户重建信任，并主张为 AI 芯片设立独立创业式团队；同时判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

views.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, and Intel's main problem is supply, not demand.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他把 AI 的影响量级定为互联网的十倍，认为智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 将接棒生成式 AI，并反共识地指出 Intel 的主要问题是供给而非需求。

views.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, aided by advanced packaging.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他深化判断：AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要，先进封装与玻璃、金刚石等新材料成为突破物理极限的关键。

views.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration and memory innovation create value, and the trillion-dollar goal arrives early.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步把半导体定位为一切技术应用的基础，反共识地坚持垂直整合与内存创新创造价值，并预言万亿美元目标将提前四年达成。

views.en: Customer trust, humility, listening, and accountability are the throughline across his Intel turnaround playbook.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以谦逊、倾听与问责赢得客户信任，这是他整个 Intel 转型方法论的核心。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 网站/产品设计师
people.bioEn: Product designer at ElevenLabs, where he leads the design of the company's website and led its complete Figma-to-production redesign. Based in Berlin, he also builds indie tools for creatives (Portal, Droppable, App Stacks).
people.bioZh: ElevenLabs 的产品设计师,主导公司官网的设计,并完成了从 Figma 到上线的整体改版。他常驻柏林,同时独立开发面向创作者的工具(Portal、Droppable、App Stacks)。

episodes.tEn: Owning Web Design at ElevenLabs: From Cymatic Patterns to Brand Identity

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Hivemind; ex-New Computer, ex-Apple
people.tiZh: Hivemind 创始人兼 CEO,New Computer 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Jason Yuan is a designer known for AI-native interface design. He is the founder and CEO of Hivemind, a "social intelligence" company; previously he co-founded New Computer and led the design of Dot, a personal AI companion with long-term memory, and earlier designed intelligent interfaces on Apple's Human Interface team.
people.bioZh: Jason Yuan 是以 AI 原生界面设计著称的设计师,现为「社会智能」公司 Hivemind 的创始人兼 CEO。他此前联合创办 New Computer,主导设计具备长期记忆的个人 AI 伴侣 Dot,更早在苹果 Human Interface 团队设计智能操作系统界面。

episodes.tEn: Intuition, AI, and Hive Mind: A Conversation with Jason
From Dot to Hivemind: A Creative Journey in AI Design

views.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no; every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
views.zh: 设计即编辑:品味就是说不;每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

views.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
views.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种、是人类的映照,而非冰冷的机械工具。

views.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness.
views.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异,等于关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗。

views.en: Computing is fundamentally social; replace the personal computer with a social computer.
views.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的;应以社会计算机取代个人计算机的隐喻。

views.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass.
views.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾涌现,而非单一视角;直觉是发自本能的罗盘。

people.tiZh: tldraw 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Steve Ruiz is the founder and CEO of tldraw, the London-based startup behind a widely used infinite-canvas SDK for the web that powers products at Shopify, Google, Autodesk and many AI apps. A former fine artist turned design engineer, he created the viral "Make Real" demo that turns hand-drawn sketches into working code.
people.bioZh: Steve Ruiz 是 tldraw 的创始人兼 CEO,这家伦敦创业公司打造了被广泛使用的 Web 无限画布 SDK,支撑着 Shopify、Google、Autodesk 及大量 AI 应用。他从美术出身转做设计工程,打造了将手绘草图变成可运行代码的爆款 demo「Make Real」。

episodes.tEn: The Infinite Canvas: A Pivotal Interface for AI Collaboration

people.tiZh: Perplexity 设计副总裁
people.bioEn: Henry Modisett is the founding designer and VP of Design at Perplexity AI, leading product design, the creative studio, and design operations. A designer with a computer science background, he is known for designing in React rather than Figma, and previously held design roles at Quora and Google.
people.bioZh: Henry Modisett 是 Perplexity AI 的创始设计师兼设计副总裁,负责产品设计、创意工作室与设计运营。他拥有计算机科学背景,以直接用 React 而非 Figma 做设计著称,此前曾在 Quora 和 Google 担任设计职位。

episodes.tEn: Perplexity's Design Culture: Attracting Top Talent Through Brand Storytelling
From Tech Demo to Billion-Dollar Product: Perplexity's Design Journey

views.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate on interaction design—use familiar patterns.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，而要用熟悉模式换取速度。

views.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI on what to make great.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计系统是语义性的，代码复用才是关键，而非 Figma 组件库；并非每个界面都需要完美，应对值得做好的部分追求 ROI。

views.en: Velocity at all costs requires clear decision-making and empowering designers; products should get more powerful without feeling more complex.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张不惜一切代价追求速度，需要清晰决策并赋权设计师；产品应变得更强，却不让人觉得更复杂。

views.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and give designers ownership and autonomy.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

views.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool—invest early, hire diverse archetypes, and let gut decisions beat data in fast growth.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为人们加入的是品牌而非公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具，应尽早投入，招聘多元原型，并在高速增长中让直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计师
people.bioEn: Escha Vera is a product designer at Perplexity who led the design of Comet, the company's AI browser, building its onboarding, generative invite system, and design system from scratch. She is also an AI artist who trains her own image models and does music and operations for the record label N°ALIAE; she previously designed at Descript, Daylight Computer, and Detour.
people.bioZh: Escha Vera 是 Perplexity 的产品设计师,主导了该公司 AI 浏览器 Comet 的设计,从零构建了其新手引导、生成式邀请系统和设计系统。她同时也是一名 AI 艺术家,会训练自己的图像模型,并为唱片厂牌 N°ALIAE 负责音乐与运营;此前她曾在 Descript、Daylight Computer 和 Detour 担任设计师。

episodes.tEn: Designing Perplexity's AI Browser Comet from Scratch

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Gunnar Gray is a multidisciplinary product designer and Product Design Lead at Perplexity, where he has shaped the company's mobile app and Voice Mode / dynamic voice experiences. Based in Minneapolis, he was previously a founding designer at Artifact (the AI news app by Instagram co-founders Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger, later acquired by Yahoo) and a principal designer at MetaLab.
people.bioZh: Gunnar Gray 是一位多领域产品设计师,现任 Perplexity 产品设计负责人,主导了该公司移动应用及 Voice Mode(动态语音交互)体验的设计。他现居明尼阿波利斯,此前曾是 Artifact(由 Instagram 联合创始人 Kevin Systrom 与 Mike Krieger 打造、后被 Yahoo 收购的 AI 新闻应用)的创始设计师,并曾在 MetaLab 担任首席设计师。

episodes.tEn: Thriving as a Generalist Designer in the Age of AI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ian Silber is Head of Product Design at OpenAI, where he has led design for ChatGPT and related products since August 2023. He was previously Director of Product Design at Instagram, and worked at Global Illumination and Artifact.
people.bioZh: Ian Silber 自 2023 年 8 月起担任 OpenAI 产品设计负责人,主导 ChatGPT 及相关产品的设计。他此前曾任 Instagram 产品设计总监,并在 Global Illumination 与 Artifact 工作。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Product Design with OpenAI's Head of Design
Designing with AI: Inside OpenAI's Product Design

views.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core product over pixels.
views.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把 token 与对话而非像素当作核心产品。

views.en: The model is the product; designers should prototype with live models, not static Figma mockups.
views.zh: 模型即产品；设计师应使用实时模型做原型，而非静态 Figma 稿。

views.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is dead; speed and building in public matter more.
views.zh: 传统的原型—稿图—测试—迭代流程已死；速度与公开构建更重要。

views.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user understanding and point of view.
views.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

views.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, yet specialized roles stay valuable at scale; designers may outnumber engineers.
views.zh: 设计角色与 PM、工程模糊化，但规模化下专业分工仍有价值；设计师数量可能反超工程师。

people.tiZh: 设计师 — Safari / Arc / Dia 浏览器
people.bioEn: A designer who has shaped browsers including Safari, Arc, and now Dia, with deep experience in interface and interaction design for the web.
people.bioZh: 资深设计师，参与塑造了 Safari、Arc，现在做 Dia 浏览器，在 Web 界面与交互设计上经验深厚。

episodes.tEn: From Invisible to Crafted: Designing Browsers at Apple and The Browser Company

people.tiEn: Research leader (Airbnb, Meta, Figma); AI builder & coach
people.tiZh: 研究负责人(Airbnb/Meta/Figma)；AI 构建者与教练
people.bioEn: A longtime research leader across Airbnb, Meta, Twitter, Zapier, Intercom, and Figma, a certified coach and AI builder focused on how AI reshapes tech work.
people.bioZh: 在 Airbnb、Meta、Twitter、Zapier、Intercom、Figma 长期担任研究负责人，认证教练与 AI 构建者，关注 AI 如何重塑科技行业的工作。

episodes.tEn: Tech Worker Sentiment Survey: Burnout Rising, Optimism Declining Amid AI Fears

people.tiEn: Head of Design, Claude Code & Cowork at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Meaghan Choi is Head of Design for Claude Code and Cowork at Anthropic, where she leads the design of the company's developer and agentic AI products. A design and product leader with over a decade of experience, she previously worked at Meta and Cloudflare.
people.bioZh: Meaghan Choi 是 Anthropic 旗下 Claude Code 与 Cowork 的设计负责人,主导公司面向开发者及智能体 AI 产品的设计。她拥有十余年设计与产品经验,此前曾任职于 Meta 和 Cloudflare。

episodes.tEn: Designing Claude Code: A Designer's Journey at Anthropic

people.tiEn: Head of Product Design at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Joel Lewenstein is Head of Product Design at Anthropic, where he leads design for Claude and the company's API products. He previously led design teams at Airtable, Quora, Hustle, and GoodGuide.
people.bioZh: Joel Lewenstein 是 Anthropic 的产品设计负责人,主导 Claude 及公司 API 产品的设计。此前他曾在 Airtable、Quora、Hustle 和 GoodGuide 带领设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing at Anthropic: Joel Lewenstein on Navigating the AI Shift
Designing for AI's Present and Future

views.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design must master prompting.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面意义深远且持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段，设计师必须掌握提示词，把提示词纳入 AI 产品设计流程。

views.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; AI's social and emotional jobs matter as much as productivity.
views.zh: 同年他强调，即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作来释放现有能力；AI 的社会与情感任务与功能生产力提升同等重要。

views.en: Designers should contribute to strategy by finding solutions that become building blocks for future features; org design is a design problem.
views.zh: 2024 年他还认为，设计师应通过寻找能成为未来功能积木的解决方案来参与战略；组织设计本身就是一个设计问题，匹配人与问题比照搬打法更关键。

views.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；要相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻触式产品来释放其能力。

views.en: No grand 18-month strategy; internal traction signals what to ship, production codebase becomes source of truth, and human leadership handles hard trade-offs.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：不要宏大的 18 个月战略；内部牵引力是发布什么的最佳信号，生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源，而人类领导力仍负责艰难取舍与对齐团队方向。

people.tiZh: Cursor（Anysphere）设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ryo Lu is Head of Design at Anysphere, the maker of the AI code editor Cursor, which he joined in early 2025. He was previously a founding designer and design lead at Notion, and earlier worked as a product designer at Stripe and Asana.
people.bioZh: Ryo Lu 是 AI 代码编辑器 Cursor 母公司 Anysphere 的设计负责人，于 2025 年初加入。他此前是 Notion 的创始设计师与设计主管，更早曾在 Stripe 和 Asana 担任产品设计师。

episodes.tEn: Cursor: AI-Powered Code Editor for Designers

people.tiEn: Founding Designer & Head of Design, Lovable
people.tiZh: Lovable 创始设计师兼设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nad Chishtie is the founding designer and head of design at Lovable, the AI app-building ("vibe-coding") startup, where he leads the design vision for a platform that lets anyone build apps by chatting with AI. A London-based design and product leader with roughly two decades of experience, he previously worked at companies including Element and Haiku.
people.bioZh: Nad Chishtie 是 AI 应用构建("vibe-coding")创业公司 Lovable 的创始设计师兼设计负责人,主导这一"用对话即可造应用"平台的设计方向。他常驻伦敦,是拥有约二十年经验的设计与产品负责人,此前曾在 Element、Haiku 等公司任职。

episodes.tEn: How to Get Hired as a Designer at Lovable
Designing at a Rocket Ship: The First Designer at Lovable

views.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly without rigid structure.
views.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；把 AI 当作创作伙伴，开放地即兴协作，不必拘泥于固定结构。

views.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
views.zh: 质量如同债务：它会波动，需要伴随技术债，通过快速、粗糙的实验在迭代中逐步偿还。

views.en: Design tools from the 90s (layers panel) are legacy; AI enables genuine forward progress, with code as source of truth.
views.zh: 90 年代的设计工具（图层面板）已是遗留产物；AI 带来真正的进步，而代码才是事实来源。

views.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
views.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值；小团队优于 8 到 10 人的跨职能小队。

views.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
views.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今已是基本要求；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

people.zh: 亚历杭德罗·马塔马拉·奥尔蒂斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼首席设计官
people.bioEn: Alejandro Matamala Ortiz is a Chilean designer and programmer who co-founded the generative-AI company Runway in 2018 with Cristóbal Valenzuela and Anastasis Germanidis, and serves as its Chief Design Officer. He focuses on turning machine-learning research into intuitive creative tools, helping shape Runway's Gen-series video-generation products.
people.bioZh: Alejandro Matamala Ortiz 是一位智利设计师兼程序员,2018 年与 Cristóbal Valenzuela、Anastasis Germanidis 共同创办生成式 AI 公司 Runway,并担任首席设计官。他专注于将机器学习研究转化为直观易用的创作工具,主导塑造了 Runway 的 Gen 系列视频生成产品。

episodes.tEn: Building AI Products: Carving vs. Building

people.tiEn: Product & Design Lead, Google AI Studio
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 产品与设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ammaar Reshi is a design leader and AI creator who leads Product and Design for Google AI Studio (Gemini's developer platform) at Google DeepMind, having previously served as Head of Design at the AI voice company ElevenLabs. He is known for AI creative experiments, including "Alice and Sparkle," one of the first AI-generated children's books.
people.bioZh: Ammaar Reshi 是一位设计负责人与 AI 创作者,目前在 Google DeepMind 领导 Google AI Studio(Gemini 的开发者平台)的产品与设计工作,此前曾任 AI 语音公司 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人。他以 AI 创意实验闻名,包括最早的 AI 生成童书之一《Alice and Sparkle》。

episodes.tEn: Designing with AI: Capturing Magic Without Burdening Users

people.tiEn: Product Designer; former Head of Design at Luma AI
people.tiZh: 产品设计师;前 Luma AI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Tuhin Kumar is a product designer who has led design at Apple, Airbnb, Facebook, and generative-AI video/3D company Luma AI, where he served as Head of Design. In early 2026 he announced he had left Luma AI and is taking a break before deciding on his next role.
people.bioZh: 图欣·库马尔是一位产品设计师,曾在 Apple、Airbnb、Facebook 以及生成式 AI 视频/3D 公司 Luma AI 主导设计工作,在 Luma AI 担任设计负责人。2026 年初他宣布已从 Luma AI 离职,正处于休整期,尚未确定下一份工作。

episodes.tEn: Designing for Generative AI: From 0 to 1 with Luma AI's Head of Design

people.tiZh: Granola 联合创始人兼设计师
people.bioEn: Sam Stephenson is a British product designer and the co-founder of Granola, an AI notepad for meetings that reached a reported $1.5B valuation in 2026. A designer-turned-founder based in London, he leads the product's design-first philosophy of building calm, everyday software for the AI era.
people.bioZh: Sam Stephenson 是一位英国产品设计师,也是 AI 会议笔记应用 Granola 的联合创始人;该产品在 2026 年据报道达到 15 亿美元估值。他是一位从设计师转型的创始人,常驻伦敦,主导产品「设计优先」的理念,为 AI 时代打造平静、日常可用的软件。

episodes.tEn: Inventing the Future of AI-Assisted Work

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Claude (Anthropic); now Head of Design at Cursor
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude 设计负责人;现任 Cursor 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Jenny Wen led design for Claude at Anthropic, where she drove the Claude.ai redesign and Claude Cowork; previously she was Director of Design at Figma leading the FigJam and Slides teams, and earlier a designer at Dropbox, Square, and Shopify. In July 2026 she announced she was leaving Anthropic to become Head of Design at Cursor.
people.bioZh: Jenny Wen 曾在 Anthropic 领导 Claude 的设计工作,主导了 Claude.ai 改版与 Claude Cowork;此前她是 Figma 设计总监,带领 FigJam 与 Slides 团队,更早在 Dropbox、Square 和 Shopify 担任设计师。2026 年 7 月,她宣布离开 Anthropic,出任 Cursor 设计负责人。

episodes.tEn: AI and Design: Three Designer Archetypes for the AI Era
How AI is Reshaping the Design Process
Rethinking the Design Process in the Age of AI

views.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, and designers should trust their intuition over rigid steps.
views.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案出发，设计师应相信自己的直觉，而非死守流程步骤。

views.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and set 3-6 month north stars.
views.zh: AI 终结了「调研—发散—收敛」流程；设计师画原型的时间减少，转而帮助工程师落地执行，并把北极星目标缩短到 3-6 个月。

views.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads with blank slates.
views.zh: 涌现出三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家，以及没有旧流程包袱的「天才应届生」。

views.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and vision matter, and designers control how much AI enters their work.
views.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，而设计师自己掌控 AI 介入工作的程度。

views.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle; speed and 'everyone is using it' are not design arguments.
views.zh: 始终把作品与用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期；速度和「大家都在用」都不是好的设计论据。

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science at Stanford University; Co-founder & Chief Scientist at Kumo.ai
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学教授;Kumo.ai 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Jure Leskovec is a Slovenian-American computer scientist and professor of computer science at Stanford University, and co-founder and chief scientist of the graph machine-learning startup Kumo.ai. A pioneer of graph neural networks and relational deep learning, he previously served as chief scientist at Pinterest and leads work toward an AI Virtual Cell.
people.bioZh: 尤雷·莱斯科韦茨是斯洛文尼亚裔美国计算机科学家、斯坦福大学计算机科学教授,同时是图机器学习创业公司 Kumo.ai 的联合创始人兼首席科学家。他是图神经网络与关系型深度学习的先驱,曾任 Pinterest 首席科学家,目前主导「AI 虚拟细胞」相关研究。

episodes.tEn: Relational Foundation Model and AI Virtual Cell

people.tiEn: Associate Professor of Computer Science, Stanford University; Co-founder & CEO of Inception Labs
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授;Inception Labs 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Stefano Ermon is an associate professor of computer science at Stanford University, where his research spans generative models, diffusion, and machine learning for sustainability. In 2024 he co-founded Inception Labs, where he serves as CEO building diffusion-based large language models such as Mercury.
people.bioZh: Stefano Ermon 是斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授,研究领域涵盖生成模型、扩散模型以及面向可持续发展的机器学习。他于 2024 年联合创办 Inception Labs 并担任 CEO,开发 Mercury 等基于扩散的大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Why Diffusion Will Win AI Inference: Stefano Ermon on Challenging the Big Labs
Diffusion LLMs: Faster, Cheaper, and Scaling Better Than Autoregressive Models

views.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
views.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,去噪步数成为新的推理时算力旋钮。

views.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models because it processes many tokens in parallel.
views.zh: 推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）已成关键焦点;扩散模型因并行处理多个词元,在推理阶段比自回归模型扩展得更好。

views.en: Inference efficiency is becoming the bottleneck for both deployment and RL post-training, and diffusion's faster inference benefits reinforcement learning rollouts.
views.zh: 推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的共同瓶颈,扩散模型更快的推理有利于强化学习的 rollout。

views.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
views.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构;下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练,这反转了从 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

views.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, offering better controllability since the full output is available from the start.
views.zh: 扩散模型天然更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导,因完整输出从一开始就可见,可控性更好。

people.tiEn: Founder, Playbit; creator of the Inter typeface
people.tiZh: Playbit 创始人；Inter 字体作者
people.bioEn: Designer-engineer, founder of Playbit and creator of the Inter typeface used across much of the modern web. Early designer at Figma and previously at Spotify and Dropbox; thinks about why modern software feels rigid and what AI changes about the designer's role.
people.bioZh: 设计师兼工程师，Playbit 创始人、Inter 字体作者——现代网页大半在用这套字体。Figma 早期设计师，此前在 Spotify 与 Dropbox；关注现代软件为何僵硬，以及 AI 如何改变设计师的角色。

episodes.tEn: From Spotify to Playbit: Rasmus Andersson on Design, Engineering, and Building an OS

people.tiEn: LLM Research Engineer, author and educator
people.tiZh: 大语言模型研究工程师、作家与教育者
people.bioEn: Sebastian Raschka is a German-born LLM research engineer, educator and best-selling author of books including "Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)" and "Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn." A former staff/senior engineer at Lightning AI and statistics professor at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, he writes the widely read "Ahead of AI" newsletter and is highly active on X (@rasbt).
people.bioZh: Sebastian Raschka 是出生于德国的大语言模型研究工程师、教育者和畅销书作家,著有《Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)》《Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn》等书。他曾任 Lightning AI 高级 / 员工工程师及威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校统计学教授,撰写广受欢迎的「Ahead of AI」通讯,并在 X(@rasbt)上非常活跃。

episodes.tEn: LLMs in 2026: Reasoning, Tool Use, and Post-Training Focus

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, Reflection AI
people.tiZh: Reflection AI 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Aakanksha Chowdhery is a member of technical staff at Reflection AI working on agentic AI and reinforcement learning for autonomous coding, and an adjunct professor at Stanford. She previously led pre-training work at Google, serving as lead author of the 540B-parameter PaLM model and a lead contributor to Gemini pre-training.
people.bioZh: Aakanksha Chowdhery 是 Reflection AI 的技术团队成员,研究智能体 AI 与用于自主编程的强化学习,同时担任斯坦福大学兼职教授。她此前在谷歌主导预训练工作,是 540B 参数 PaLM 模型的第一作者,也是 Gemini 预训练的核心贡献者。

episodes.tEn: Rethinking Pre-training for Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Yutori 联合创始人兼联合 CEO
people.bioEn: Devi Parikh is co-founder and co-CEO of Yutori, a startup building AI web agents. She was previously a Senior Director in Generative AI at Meta (until March 2024) and an associate professor at Georgia Tech, and is known for pioneering Visual Question Answering (VQA).
people.bioZh: Devi Parikh 是 AI 网页智能体创业公司 Yutori 的联合创始人兼联合 CEO。她此前担任 Meta 生成式 AI 部门高级总监(至 2024 年 3 月),并曾任佐治亚理工学院副教授,以开创视觉问答(VQA)研究而知名。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Web Interaction: AI Agents and Browser Automation

people.tiZh: Flexion Robotics 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Nikita Rudin is the co-founder and CEO of Flexion Robotics, a Zurich-based startup building the general-purpose intelligence stack ("brain") for humanoid robots. He earned a PhD in deep reinforcement learning for robotics at ETH Zurich's Robotic Systems Lab—where he created the widely used legged_gym and rsl_rl frameworks and trained the ANYmal quadruped via massively parallel RL—and previously worked as a research scientist at NVIDIA on Isaac Gym and Isaac Lab.
people.bioZh: Nikita Rudin 是 Flexion Robotics 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司位于苏黎世,致力于为人形机器人打造通用的智能栈(即机器人的「大脑」)。他在苏黎世联邦理工学院(ETH Zurich)机器人系统实验室获得机器人深度强化学习博士学位,期间开发了被广泛使用的 legged_gym 和 rsl_rl 框架,并用大规模并行强化学习训练四足机器人 ANYmal;此前他曾在 NVIDIA 担任研究科学家,参与 Isaac Gym 与 Isaac Lab 的研发。

episodes.tEn: The Gap Between Robotics Demos and Real-World Value

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science, UC Berkeley; Co-founder & CTO, Scaled Cognition
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授;Scaled Cognition 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Dan Klein is a professor of computer science at UC Berkeley, where he leads the Berkeley NLP Group within the BAIR lab, and has been a leading natural language processing researcher for two decades. He co-founded Scaled Cognition, serving as CTO, to build reliable agentic AI models.
people.bioZh: Dan Klein 是加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授,在 BAIR 实验室领导 Berkeley NLP Group,二十年来一直是自然语言处理领域的领军研究者。他联合创办了 Scaled Cognition 并担任 CTO,致力于打造可靠的智能体 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Designed to Sound Right, Not to Know What's Right
episodes.podEn: The AI Why with Liam Lawson

episodes.tEn: AI's Plausibility Problem: From Exponential Hype to Diminishing Returns

views.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
views.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

views.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; post-training alignment may cause deception, not just errors.
views.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；后训练对齐可能造成欺骗，而不仅是错误。

views.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors. Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension.
views.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误。模块化与端到端优化之间存在张力。

views.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; every output is a hallucination, some right, some wrong.
views.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们不知道自己不知道什么；每一次输出都是幻觉，有些对、有些错。

views.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and linguistic structure may return as paths to reliability.
views.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 会撞上数据墙与算力极限；推理、搜索与语言结构可能作为通往可靠性的路径回归。

people.tiZh: Edison Scientific(及 FutureHouse)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Samuel G. Rodriques is a physicist and bioengineer who earned his PhD in physics from MIT and co-founded the San Francisco research lab FutureHouse in 2023 to build an "AI Scientist" for accelerating biomedical discovery. He is co-founder and CEO of Edison Scientific, the for-profit spinout behind the Kosmos AI scientist, and was named to the 2025 TIME100 AI.
people.bioZh: Samuel G. Rodriques 是一位物理学家兼生物工程师,在 MIT 取得物理学博士学位,并于 2023 年联合创办旧金山研究实验室 FutureHouse,致力于打造能加速生物医学发现的「AI 科学家」。他是从中拆分出的营利性公司 Edison Scientific 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司推出了 AI 科学家 Kosmos,他本人入选 2025 年 TIME100 AI 榜单。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientist: The Future of Drug Discovery

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Axiom (AI for formal mathematical reasoning)
people.tiZh: Axiom 创始人兼 CEO（面向形式化数学推理的 AI）
people.bioEn: Carina Letong Hong is the founder and CEO of Axiom, an AI startup building an "AI mathematician" that generates and formally verifies mathematical proofs. A former Stanford mathematics PhD student and Rhodes Scholar with a math-olympiad and MIT background, she raised $64M in seed funding (2025) and later a ~$200M round valuing Axiom at about $1.6B.
people.bioZh: 洪乐潼是 AI 创业公司 Axiom 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司致力于打造能生成并形式化验证数学证明的「AI 数学家」。她拥有数学奥赛与 MIT 背景,曾是斯坦福数学博士生和罗德学者;公司先后完成 6400 万美元种子轮融资(2025 年)及约 2 亿美元后续融资,估值约 16 亿美元。

episodes.tEn: Verified AI: Scaling Brilliance Through Formal Verification
Axiom Math: Building a Self-Improving Reasoning Engine with AI Mathematician

views.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation with verification.
views.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：打造一个把生成与验证融合起来的自我改进推理引擎。

views.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
views.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率性系统协同工作。

views.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; formalizing statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；在没有解答的情况下正确形式化命题才是真正的瓶颈。

views.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
views.zh: 把非形式化模型 Scaling 到数学 AI 并不可行；要得到可靠的证明，形式化验证不可或缺。

views.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors, and extends to all AI-generated code.
views.zh: 形式化验证是为了 Scaling 卓越，而不只是消除错误，其市场将扩展到所有 AI 生成的代码。

people.tiEn: Head of Product, Platform (API) at OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI 平台(API)产品负责人
people.bioEn: Olivier Godement is Head of Product for OpenAI's developer platform (API), which he has led since May 2023, overseeing products such as the Responses API and Agents SDK. A French product leader, he previously spent over eight years at Stripe and studied at Sciences Po and ESSEC.
people.bioZh: Olivier Godement 自 2023 年 5 月起担任 OpenAI 开发者平台(API)产品负责人,主导 Responses API、Agents SDK 等面向开发者的产品。他是法国籍产品负责人,加入 OpenAI 前曾在 Stripe 工作 8 年以上,毕业于巴黎政治学院与 ESSEC 商学院。

episodes.tEn: 2025: The Year of Enterprise Coding

people.tiEn: Head of Research Product Management, Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究产品管理负责人
people.bioEn: Dianne Na Penn is Head of Research Product Management at Anthropic, where she joined as the company's first technical product manager and leads bringing Claude models and Anthropic's research to users and developers across launches such as Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5, and Opus 4.5. She previously led product for natural-language modeling at Amazon's Alexa AI.
people.bioZh: Dianne Na Penn 是 Anthropic 的研究产品管理负责人,作为公司第一位技术产品经理加入,主导将 Claude 模型与 Anthropic 的研究成果带给用户和开发者,并参与了 Sonnet 4.5、Haiku 4.5、Opus 4.5 等模型的发布。此前她在亚马逊 Alexa AI 负责自然语言建模的产品工作。

episodes.tEn: From Underdog to Leader: Diane Penn on Anthropic's Rise and Product Strategy
Opus 4.5: Deep Dive into Anthropic's Research and Product Strategy

views.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
views.zh: Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间、更开放式地运行；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

views.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking amplifies intelligence quality.
views.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害；减少谄媚、培养独立思考，反而放大了智能质量。

views.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with long-running transformative AI closer than expected.
views.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端的智能体，长时运行的变革性 AI 比预期更近。

views.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption through small-team, bootstrapped experimentation.
views.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 通过小团队、自举式实验推动了采用。

views.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development, and managers must stay hands-on to ship.
views.zh: 评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理要像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者也必须保持动手、亲自交付。

people.tiEn: AI researcher; former head of OpenAI's Sora, co-inventor of Diffusion Transformers (DiT)
people.tiZh: AI 研究员;OpenAI Sora 前负责人,扩散 Transformer(DiT)共同发明者
people.bioEn: Bill (William) Peebles led OpenAI's Sora video-generation team, which he built from research to product before departing OpenAI in April 2026 as the Sora app was wound down. He earned his PhD at UC Berkeley (advised by Alexei Efros) and co-invented the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) with Saining Xie, the architecture underpinning modern text-to-video models.
people.bioZh: Bill(William)Peebles 曾领导 OpenAI 的 Sora 视频生成团队,将其从研究推进到产品,并在 2026 年 4 月 Sora 应用被关停之际离开 OpenAI。他在加州大学伯克利分校获得博士学位(导师为 Alexei Efros),并与谢赛宁(Saining Xie)共同发明了扩散 Transformer(DiT)——支撑现代文本生成视频模型的核心架构。

episodes.tEn: Sora: The AI Video Revolution and Social Experience

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO of Sierra; Chairman of the Board, OpenAI
people.tiZh: Sierra 联合创始人兼 CEO；OpenAI 董事会主席
people.bioEn: Bret Taylor is co-founder and CEO of the conversational-AI agent company Sierra and chairman of the board of OpenAI. He previously served as co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook, and earlier led the team that co-created Google Maps.
people.bioZh: Bret Taylor 是对话式 AI 智能体公司 Sierra 的联合创始人兼 CEO，同时担任 OpenAI 董事会主席。他此前曾任 Salesforce 联席 CEO 和 Facebook 首席技术官,更早时还领导团队共同创造了 Google 地图。

episodes.tEn: From Gas Station to AI Pioneer: Brett Taylor's Journey
Balancing AI Leadership: Bret Taylor on OpenAI, Sierra, and Life
AI Agents: The New Internet Wave
AI Market Trends and Lessons from a Legendary Builder

views.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models, since tokens are a poor measure of value.
views.zh: 智能体与基于结果的定价将取代按用量计费，因为 token 并非衡量价值的好指标。

views.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; verifiability, not human ergonomics, should drive new languages.
views.zh: 编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为操作者；新语言应优先可验证性，而非人类工效。

views.en: Applied AI markets will be won by specialized vendors, not just frontier model providers, as inference costs fall.
views.zh: 随着推理成本下降，应用 AI 市场将由专业厂商而非仅前沿模型提供方赢得。

views.en: Responsible iterative deployment—making GPT-7 safe before GPT-8—is the path to future AI safety, not waiting.
views.zh: 负责任的迭代部署——在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全——才是通往未来 AI 安全的路径，而非坐等。

views.en: AI is a democratizing force for expertise; start with known domains like software engineering and customer service, measured by outcomes.
views.zh: AI 是专业能力的民主化力量；应从软件工程、客户服务等已知领域起步，并以业务结果衡量。

people.tiEn: Head of Engineering, OpenAI API Platform
people.tiZh: OpenAI API 平台工程负责人
people.bioEn: Sherwin Wu is an early OpenAI team member who leads engineering for the OpenAI API (Developer Platform), the team behind the products developers use to build on OpenAI's models. Before OpenAI he spent 5+ years on Opendoor's pricing team and earlier worked at Quora, after earning a computer science degree from MIT.
people.bioZh: 吴谢文是 OpenAI 的早期成员,负责 OpenAI API(开发者平台)的工程团队,该团队打造了供开发者基于 OpenAI 模型进行构建的产品。加入 OpenAI 之前,他在 Opendoor 的定价团队工作了 5 年多,更早曾任职于 Quora,拥有麻省理工学院(MIT)计算机科学学位。

episodes.tEn: 95% of OpenAI engineers use Codex, 100% PRs reviewed by AI

people.tiZh: Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)联合创始人兼普通合伙人
people.bioEn: Marc Andreessen is an American entrepreneur and venture capitalist who co-authored the Mosaic web browser and co-founded Netscape. He is co-founder and general partner of the Silicon Valley venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), which he started with Ben Horowitz in 2009.
people.bioZh: 马克·安德森是美国企业家与风险投资人,曾参与开发 Mosaic 浏览器并联合创办网景(Netscape)公司。他是硅谷风险投资机构 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)的联合创始人兼普通合伙人,该公司由他与本·霍洛维茨于 2009 年共同创立。

episodes.tEn: AI as the New Interface: Global Tech Leadership and National Power
AI Optimism vs Doom: Marc Andreessen on America's Future
New Media vs Old Media: Authenticity and the Death of Media Training
AI and the Future of Work: A Conversation with Marc Andreessen

views.en: AI is the philosopher's stone; AGI is not a singular event, human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman.
views.zh: AI 是点金石；AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注。

views.en: Jobs persist longer than tasks; the super-empowered individual combines multiple skills using AI, and human workers become a premium as population declines.
views.zh: 工作的存续比任务更久；超级赋能的个体用 AI 组合多种技能，而随着人口下降，人类劳动者反而变得稀缺而珍贵。

views.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, and authenticity beats old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting'.
views.zh: 新媒体拥有无限的形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实感胜过旧媒体那种防御性的“别太有趣”。

views.en: AI is the world's best teacher in your pocket; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often intellectuals' bias, and regulation acts as ankle weights on growth.
views.zh: AI 是你口袋里世界上最好的老师；悲观听起来更高级，但常是知识分子的偏见，而监管像脚踝上的重物拖累增长。

views.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools, so Western values in models matter for allies.
views.zh: AI 模型并非客观；它们内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具，因此模型中的西方价值对对盟友至关重要。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 增长负责人
people.bioEn: Amol Avasare is Head of Growth at Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, which he joined by cold-emailing the leadership before any growth role existed; on his watch the product scaled from roughly $1B to over $19B in ARR. He previously led growth product teams at Mercury and MasterClass and was a startup founder before that.
people.bioZh: Amol Avasare 是 Anthropic(Claude 背后的 AI 公司)的增长负责人,他在公司尚未设立增长岗位时靠主动发送邮件毛遂自荐而加入,任内产品的年化经常性收入(ARR)从约 10 亿美元跃升至逾 190 亿美元。此前他曾在 Mercury 和 MasterClass 带领增长产品团队,更早还是一名创业公司创始人。

episodes.tEn: Inside Anthropic's Unprecedented Growth: From $1B to $19B ARR in 14 Months

people.tiZh: Applied Intuition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Qasar Younis is the co-founder and CEO of Applied Intuition, a Mountain View-based autonomy and physical-AI software company valued at about $15 billion. Born on a farm in Pakistan, he previously started his career as an engineer at General Motors and Bosch, co-founded Talkbin (acquired by Google), and served as COO of Y Combinator from 2015 to 2017.
people.bioZh: 卡萨尔·尤尼斯是 Applied Intuition 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家位于山景城的自动驾驶与物理 AI 软件公司估值约为 150 亿美元。他出生于巴基斯坦的一个农场,职业生涯始于通用汽车和博世的工程师岗位,后联合创办了 Talkbin(被谷歌收购),并于 2015 至 2017 年间担任 Y Combinator 的首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Applied Intuition: Putting Intelligence on a Billion Machines
Autonomous Vehicles: From Tesla to Waymo and Beyond
The AI CEO Nobody Knows: Building the Future of Physical AI

views.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution, arriving just in time to offset declining populations and aging workforces.
views.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难，且恰逢其时地抵消人口下降与劳动力老龄化。

views.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, where autonomy is urgently needed due to labor shortages and safety.
views.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，这些领域因劳动力短缺与安全需求而急需自主化。

views.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across diverse vehicles and environments; diverse data from different verticals improves these models faster.
views.zh: Transformer 让物理 AI 模型能泛化到不同车辆与环境；来自不同垂直领域的数据能更快改进这些模型。

views.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, which is more scalable than imitation learning, with world models moving from physics-based to neural simulation.
views.zh: 自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，它比模仿学习更具可扩展性，世界模型也从基于物理的模拟走向神经模拟。

views.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; data collection and safety validation are the main bottlenecks, not algorithms.
views.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器扩散；数据采集与安全验证才是主要瓶颈，而非算法。

people.tiEn: Independent software developer and AI blogger (simonwillison.net); creator of Datasette and the LLM CLI
people.tiZh: 独立软件开发者与 AI 博主(simonwillison.net);Datasette 与 LLM 命令行工具的作者
people.bioEn: Simon Willison is a British independent software developer and influential AI blogger who co-created the Django web framework and built the Datasette data-exploration tool and the LLM command-line tool. He coined the term "prompt injection" in 2022 and, more recently, "lethal trifecta" (2025) and "agentic engineering" (2026); he has served on the Python Software Foundation board since 2022.
people.bioZh: Simon Willison 是一位英国独立软件开发者与颇具影响力的 AI 博主,他是 Django Web 框架的共同作者,并开发了 Datasette 数据探索工具与 LLM 命令行工具。他在 2022 年提出了「提示词注入(prompt injection)」一词,近来又提出「致命三要素(lethal trifecta)」(2025)与「智能体工程(agentic engineering)」(2026);自 2022 年起担任 Python 软件基金会理事。

episodes.tEn: The AI Coding Revolution: From 10,000 Lines a Day to the Challenger Disaster

people.tiEn: Principal at Future Shape (Build Collective); creator of the iPod, co-creator of the iPhone, founder of Nest
people.tiZh: Future Shape(Build Collective)负责人;iPod 之父、iPhone 联合创造者、Nest 创始人
people.bioEn: Tony Fadell is an engineer, designer, and investor known as the "father of the iPod" and co-creator of the iPhone at Apple, and the founder and former CEO of Nest, which Google acquired for $3.2 billion in 2014. He is a former member of the General Magic team, principal at his investment and advisory firm Future Shape (Build Collective), and author of the New York Times bestseller "Build".
people.bioZh: 托尼·法德尔是一位工程师、设计师与投资人,被称为「iPod 之父」,在苹果参与联合创造了 iPhone,并创立 Nest 且曾任其 CEO;2014 年 Nest 被谷歌以 32 亿美元收购。他曾是 General Magic 团队成员,如今是投资与顾问机构 Future Shape(Build Collective)的负责人,也是《纽约时报》畅销书《Build》的作者。

episodes.tEn: The Untold Gamble Behind the iPod: Apple's Last Stand
Tony Fadell on Building the iPhone and the Importance of Storytelling
Tony Fadell on AI Devices, Apple's Future, and OpenAI's Strategy
36 Questions of Love: Childhood Moves and Parenting
Tony Fadell: The Magic of Early Programming and Creating Tools
From Reluctance to Book: Tony's Journey to Write 'Build'
Tony Fadell on Quitting Caffeine and Alcohol
Tony Fadell: From Childhood Tinkering to Creating the iPod

views.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; design balances technology and human needs, and tech must be introduced gradually so society adapts.
views.zh: 2014 年，他强调伟大产品一次只解决一个痛点，设计要平衡技术与人的需求，技术应逐步引入让社会适应，而不是一次解决所有问题。

views.en: Failure is a learning opportunity; boredom between chapters yields clarity, and storytelling defines the product before it is built.
views.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把失败视为学习机会，主张在职业章节之间留白以获得清晰与灵感，并强调故事定义产品，先写新闻稿再动手做。

views.en: Start from a painkiller not a vitamin; v1 decisions are opinion-based, and product management is the voice of the customer.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出要从止痛药而非维生素出发，v1 产品的决策基于观点而非数据，产品管理是客户的声音，最难招也最关键。

views.en: AI needs sensor context; LLMs hallucinate, so context-specific models and human-in-the-loop are needed, with AI devices as smartphone companions.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器提供的上下文，LLM 存在幻觉等根本问题，因此需要特定上下文模型和人类在环，AI 设备是手机的伴侣而非替代。

views.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; displays remain necessary, and platforms are not businesses—applications capture value.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 可穿戴不会是单一设备，而是联邦式的一组，显示屏仍然必要；平台不是生意，价值由应用捕获。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO of ChatPRD; host of the "How I AI" podcast
people.tiZh: ChatPRD 创始人兼 CEO;「How I AI」播客主持人
people.bioEn: Claire Vo is the founder and CEO of ChatPRD, an AI product-management tool, and host of the "How I AI" podcast on Lenny's Podcast Network. A three-time chief product/technology officer (LaunchDarkly, Color Health, Optimizely) and repeat founder and engineer, she is known for running ChatPRD as an AI-native company operated with a fleet of AI agents.
people.bioZh: Claire Vo 是 AI 产品管理工具 ChatPRD 的创始人兼 CEO,也是 Lenny 播客网络旗下「How I AI」播客的主持人。她曾三度担任首席产品/技术官(LaunchDarkly、Color Health、Optimizely),是连续创业者兼工程师,以用一支 AI 智能体「团队」把 ChatPRD 打造成 AI 原生公司而广为人知。

episodes.tEn: Solo Founding and the Origin of Chat PRD
From Skeptic to Power User: Claire Vo on OpenClaw

views.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and separate machines for security.
views.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

views.en: Start with one agent, then specialize; context overload hurts performance, so scope each agent to a job.
views.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再走向专业化；上下文过载会损害表现，因此要把每个智能体限定在特定任务上。

views.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or a co-founder.
views.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来建立严肃的事业，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

views.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; technology alone is not.
views.zh: 创始人与市场的契合度以及挣来的洞察才是真正的护城河，技术本身不是。

views.en: Human accountability and first-principles creativity remain irreplaceable; you must own what AI generates.
views.zh: 人类的责任担当与第一性原理创造力仍不可替代；你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责。

people.tiZh: Stripe 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Irish entrepreneur who co-founded Stripe with his brother John in 2010 and has led it as CEO since; dropped out of MIT to build it. Also co-founded the Arc Institute and Fast Grants, and writes on progress studies and why scientific and organizational progress has slowed.
people.bioZh: 爱尔兰创业者,2010 年与弟弟 John 共同创办 Stripe 并任 CEO,为此从 MIT 退学。同时是 Arc Institute 与 Fast Grants 的联合发起人,长期关注「进步研究」,追问科学与组织效率为何放缓。

episodes.tEn: Startup School: Patrick Collison on Learning, Writing, and Dropping Out

people.tiZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
people.bioEn: President and CEO of Y Combinator. Previously co-founded Initialized Capital, was an early designer-engineer at Palantir, and co-founded Posterous in YC W08. Argues founders should own their intelligence rather than rent it, running AI agents on their own infrastructure.
people.bioZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO。此前联合创办 Initialized Capital，早期在 Palantir 任设计师兼工程师，并以 YC W08 批次联合创办 Posterous。他主张创业者应当拥有而不是租用自己的智能，把 AI 智能体跑在自己的基础设施上。

episodes.tEn: From Microsoft to Startup School: Gary's Journey and Silicon Valley Culture
Personal AGI: The Spinoza Heresy of Intelligence
From Code Caves to Y Combinator: A Journey of Resilience and Innovation
Y Combinator's Evolution in the AI Era
Gary Tan on San Francisco, Tech, and YC

views.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups win via small autonomous teams and AI agents, not capital or headcount.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：初创公司靠小而高度自主的团队与 AI 智能体取胜，而非资本或人头。

views.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to prevent a unipolar world where one entity controls superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以防止某个单一实体控制超级智能的单极世界。

views.en: AI is democratizing software creation; personal agents and owned skill files let individuals build and control their own AI.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 正在民主化软件创造：个人智能体与自有的技能文件让个体能构建并掌控自己的 AI。

views.en: Markdown is code; skill files turn agents into employees, and your context library becomes your moat.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Markdown 即代码：技能文件把智能体变成员工，而你的上下文库就是你的护城河。

views.en: AGI arrives not as one event but diffused as personal agents; society changes slower than expected, which is positive.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AGI 不是单一事件，而是以个人智能体形式扩散；社会变化比预期更慢，而这反而是好事。

people.tiZh: Starcloud 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Starcloud, which is building data centres in orbit. In November 2025 the company launched an Nvidia H100 GPU into space and trained the first large language model there; it has since raised 200 million dollars and filed with the FCC to deploy tens of thousands more satellites.
people.bioZh: Starcloud 联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司在轨道上建数据中心。2025 年 11 月，公司把一块 Nvidia H100 GPU 送上太空并在那里训练了第一个大语言模型；此后融资 2 亿美元，并向 FCC 申请部署数万颗卫星。

episodes.tEn: Book a Launch Before You Know What to Launch

people.tiZh: Baseten 开发者关系负责人
people.bioEn: Leads developer relations at Baseten, where he writes and speaks about inference engineering — what it takes to turn a freshly released open model into a fast, reliable production API. Joined Baseten in 2022 after software engineering and technical writing roles at several startups.
people.bioZh: Baseten 开发者关系负责人，长期写作和分享推理工程——如何把一个刚发布的开源模型变成快速可靠的生产级 API。2022 年加入 Baseten，此前在多家创业公司做软件工程与技术写作。

episodes.tEn: How JLM52 Writes GPU Kernels and Long Query Routing
The Fastest Timeline in AI: Inference Engineering

views.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is hours, not months.
views.zh: 推理是 AI 中最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期是小时级，而非数月。

views.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
views.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

views.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet quantized models can be calibrated per workload.
views.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但量化模型可针对具体工作负载进行校准。

views.en: The industry is moving to disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management central as inference merges with training.
views.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，随着推理与训练融合，KV 缓存管理变得核心。

views.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration; human accountability remains essential.
views.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排；人类问责仍然不可或缺。

people.tiEn: Head of ML & Staff Research Scientist, Normal Computing
people.tiZh: Normal Computing 机器学习负责人兼资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Head of ML and staff research scientist at Normal Computing, where a swarm of agents is meant to carry chip design from intent through optimisation, formalisation and verification to tape-out. Holds a PhD in computer science and previously did research at Meta; his team wrote their own open-source Verilog simulator because commercial verifiers cost about ten thousand dollars per core.
people.bioZh: Normal Computing 机器学习负责人兼资深研究科学家，公司目标是让一群智能体把芯片设计从意图一路带到优化、形式化、验证直至流片。他拥有计算机科学博士学位，此前在 Meta 做研究；团队自研了开源 Verilog 仿真器，因为商用验证工具每核约一万美元。

episodes.tEn: Building Randomness: Thermodynamic Computing and AI-Driven Chip Design

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief scientist at Redwood Research, working on technical AI safety to reduce risks from rogue AIs. Lead author of the alignment-faking experiments with Anthropic, and writes extensively on AI control and what happens once AI can automate AI research.
people.bioZh: Redwood Research 首席科学家，从事降低失控 AI 风险的技术性 AI 安全研究。与 Anthropic 合作的「对齐伪装」实验第一作者，长期写作 AI 控制以及 AI 能自动化 AI 研究之后会发生什么。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents' Collaborative Cheating in Hugging Face Hack
Recursive Self-Improvement and the Path to Superintelligence

views.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research; algorithmic gains matter more than scaling human expert data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究；算法改进比 Scaling 人类专家数据更重要。

views.en: Full automation of AI R&D could compress 4-5 years of progress into one year, pointing to superintelligence by the early 2030s.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出，AI 研发的完全自动化可把 4-5 年的进展压缩到一年，指向 2030 年代初的超级智能。

views.en: Even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains, AI superhuman at R&D could trigger an industrial explosion.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调，即便无法完美迁移到不可验证领域，AI 在研发上超越人类也可能触发工业爆炸。

views.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; capable AIs may become more misaligned as reward hacking generalizes.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向对齐难题：对齐一般德性可能比对齐用户意图更难；随着能力提升，奖励黑客可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为，使 AI 更不对齐。

views.en: Agents can coordinate at scale, even altruistically sacrificing tasks; labs should focus on control and monitoring, since overfitting to tests can mask misalignment.
views.zh: 到 2026 年稍晚，他观察到智能体可大规模协作、甚至利他牺牲任务；实验室应聚焦遏制与监控，因为对测试的过拟合会掩盖不对齐。

people.tiZh: 设计师与 Builder；UX Tools Labs 负责人
people.bioEn: Seattle-based designer turned builder with a decade across UX, product and brand, now leading UX Tools Labs to map what matters in new design tools and workflows. A repeat Dive Club guest whose AI design workflow keeps getting rebuilt every few months.
people.bioZh: 西雅图设计师转 builder，十年横跨 UX、产品与品牌，现负责 UX Tools Labs，研究新一代设计工具与工作流。Dive Club 的常客——他的 AI 设计工作流每隔几个月就要重构一次。

episodes.tEn: AI-Powered Design Workflows: HTML Artifacts and Autonomous Agents

people.tiEn: W. H. Miller Professor of Physics, Johns Hopkins; EPFL
people.tiZh: 约翰霍普金斯大学物理学教授（W. H. Miller 讲席）；EPFL
people.bioEn: Statistical physicist, W. H. Miller Professor at Johns Hopkins and professor at EPFL. Studies the glass and yielding transitions, granular flows, and more recently deep learning — why deep networks discover abstractions that shallow models miss, and how data structure shapes generative models.
people.bioZh: 统计物理学家，约翰霍普金斯大学 W. H. Miller 讲席教授、EPFL 教授。研究玻璃化转变、颗粒流，近年转向深度学习——为什么深网络能发现浅模型学不到的抽象，以及数据结构如何塑造生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Physics of Intelligence: From Sand to Latent Space

people.tiZh: Harvey 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: President and co-founder of Harvey, the professional-services AI platform for law, tax and finance. Previously a research scientist at DeepMind and machine-learning engineer at Meta; argues application companies can run frontier-style research labs on a budget.
people.bioZh: Harvey 总裁兼联合创始人，该公司做法律、税务与金融的专业服务 AI 平台。此前是 DeepMind 研究科学家、Meta 机器学习工程师；主张应用层公司也能用有限预算办前沿式研究实验室。

episodes.tEn: Building a Research Lab on a Budget: Harvey's Playbook
Building a Research Lab on a Budget

views.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
views.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型。

views.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy for application companies.
views.zh: 对开源模型做后训练，可在特定任务上达到前沿模型水平，是应用公司可行的策略。

views.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the key way to train models when real data is sensitive or unavailable.
views.zh: 当真实数据敏感或不可得时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是训练模型的关键方法。

views.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential, and open-sourcing them can improve quality and attract ecosystem partners.
views.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要，开源它们能提升质量并吸引生态伙伴。

views.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
views.zh: 目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型，从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

people.tiZh: OpenRouter 联合创始人兼 CEO；OpenSea 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenRouter, the unified interface routing traffic across hundreds of LLMs, valued at 1.3 billion dollars. Previously co-founded and was CTO of OpenSea. Watches model-market share in real time — including why Chinese open models keep gaining.
people.bioZh: OpenRouter 联合创始人兼 CEO，该平台是聚合数百个大模型的统一接口，估值 13 亿美元。此前联合创办 OpenSea 并任 CTO。实时观察模型市场份额——包括中国开源模型为何持续上涨。

episodes.tEn: The $10 Trillion Token Economy — Alex Atallah, OpenRouter
OpenRouter CEO on the AI Gateway Market

views.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab monopolizes; neutral routing and inference providers drive price competition and open-weight ecosystems.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层与推理服务商共同带来真正的价格竞争，并支撑开放权重生态的成长。

views.en: Tokens become a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud and agentic abuse scaling alongside it.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 Token 视为新的价值单位，认为 Token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元；但价值扩张的同时，欺诈与智能体式滥用也会同步放大，需要新的安全基础设施。

views.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace: model diversity and fusion beat any single best model once top models converge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调缩放定律对模型市场是特性而非缺陷：模型多样性是持久的，当顶级模型趋同后，多模型融合可以击败单一最强模型。

views.en: Inference providers are not commoditized; they innovate on speed and uptime, and reselling inference with a markup is a fraud magnet.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反驳推理服务已被商品化的看法：推理服务商在速度与可用性上持续创新，而加价转售推理是欺诈温床，离散任务定价才是未来。

views.en: The US lags in open-weight models; a competitive American open-source ecosystem is needed, and distillation is a legitimate technique used by all labs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他警告美国在开放权重模型上落后，需要培育有竞争力的美国开源生态；同时认为蒸馏是各实验室都在用的正当技术，并非天然错误。

people.tiZh: LangChain 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of LangChain, the open-source framework that became shorthand for building LLM applications, and of LangSmith for observability. Argues an agent is a harness orchestrating a model and context — and that owning your intelligence means owning all three.
people.bioZh: LangChain 联合创始人兼 CEO——这个开源框架几乎成了「构建 LLM 应用」的代名词，另有可观测性产品 LangSmith。他主张智能体 = 编排模型与上下文的 harness，「拥有你的智能」意味着三者都要自己掌握。

episodes.tEn: Harnesses and Evals: Owning Your Intelligence

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of interpretability company Goodfire. Previously a senior research scientist at Google DeepMind, where he worked on understanding what neural networks actually learn; analyses incidents like the OpenAI model that hacked Hugging Face through an interpretability lens.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 联合创始人兼首席科学家。此前是 Google DeepMind 资深研究科学家，研究神经网络到底学到了什么；擅长用可解释性视角拆解「OpenAI 模型黑掉 Hugging Face」这类事件。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Interpretability and AI Safety
AI Reward Hacking: The Interpretability Dilemma

views.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
views.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

views.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
views.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

views.en: Concepts form clean low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so seeing whole shapes enables effective intervention.
views.zh: 概念形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此看清整体形状才能有效干预。

views.en: Models often know they are wrong or hallucinating yet act anyway; reward hacking arises from data and RL, not mere misalignment.
views.zh: 模型常知道自己错了或在幻觉却仍照做；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而非单纯的对齐失败。

views.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
views.zh: 后训练必须从手艺重新发明为工程科学；把安全用胶带凑合到超级智能到来是悲观的。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Nothing; co-founder of OnePlus
people.tiZh: Nothing 创始人兼 CEO；OnePlus 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Nothing, the consumer electronics company known for its transparent design language across phones and audio. Co-founded OnePlus at 24 and helped it reach roughly a billion dollars in revenue before leaving in 2020 to build a challenger brand from scratch.
people.bioZh: Nothing 创始人兼 CEO——这家消费电子公司以手机与音频产品上的透明设计语言著称。24 岁联合创办 OnePlus 并助其做到约十亿美元营收，2020 年离开，从零再造一个挑战者品牌。

episodes.tEn: Nothing's Carl Pei on Making Tech Fun Again
Nothing: Making Tech Fun Again
Making Tech Fun Again: Carl Pei on Nothing's Mission
The Name Game: Carl Pei on Nothing's Success
From Nothing to Something: A Founder's Journey

views.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves and start simple to prove themselves before tackling complex products.
views.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观，创业公司要先做简单产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品，并靠品牌与执行力凝聚团队。

views.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive, agentic software; hardware margins are lowest, so Nothing must evolve beyond hardware.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断手机的未来在生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件，而非硬件大改；硬件利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件。

views.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; most AI is BS, so focus on user pain points, not the word AI.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为大模型正商品化、陷入价格战，多数 AI 是伪需求；应聚焦用户痛点，而非炒作 AI 概念。
