views.en: AI shifts phones from app-based to intent-based; agents act proactively once trust is built, with privacy via local or hybrid compute.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 让手机从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务，隐私靠本地或混合算力保障。

views.en: Design and efficient marketing arbitrage differentiate challengers; make tech fun to inspire creativity, and the smartphone stays the best applied-AI device.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：设计与高效营销套利是挑战者的差异化武器，让科技有趣以激发创造力，而手机仍是应用 AI 的最佳设备。

people.tiEn: Founder, LoveFrom; former Chief Design Officer, Apple
people.tiZh: LoveFrom 创始人；前苹果首席设计官
people.bioEn: Designer behind the iMac, iPod, iPhone and Apple Watch, and Apple's chief design officer until 2019. Now runs the design firm LoveFrom, which oversees design for OpenAI's hardware effort following the acquisition of io.
people.bioZh: iMac、iPod、iPhone、Apple Watch 的设计者，2019 年前任苹果首席设计官。现主持设计公司 LoveFrom；在 OpenAI 收购 io 之后，由该公司主导 OpenAI 硬件项目的设计。

episodes.tEn: Ferrari's First Electric Car: A Controversial Risk
From Art School to Silicon Valley: A Conversation with Sir Johnny Ive
Jony Ive on the 20th Anniversary of the iPod and the Shift to Wearables

views.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
views.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人的设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

views.en: Steve Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention to resist the status quo.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，而好奇心需要刻意与决心，才能抵抗现状。

views.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; fragile ideas need gentle care and trust.
views.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他持续认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值，脆弱的好想法需要温和呵护与团队信任。

views.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；真正的简洁要表达本质，并带有喜悦与人性。

views.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity beats fake engine sounds.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张设计必须创新，否则就不是设计；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实体验胜过伪造引擎声。

people.tiEn: Consumer hardware veteran: Google Android, Xiaomi, Oculus VR
people.tiZh: 消费硬件老兵：谷歌 Android、小米、Oculus VR
people.bioEn: One of the defining consumer-hardware operators of the past decade: VP of Android product management at Google, then VP International at Xiaomi in Beijing, then head of VR at Facebook/Oculus. Now building health tools as CEO of Detect.
people.bioZh: 过去十年最有代表性的消费硬件操盘手之一：先后任谷歌 Android 产品管理副总裁、小米国际业务副总裁（常驻北京）、Facebook/Oculus VR 负责人。现为健康工具公司 Detect 的 CEO。

episodes.tEn: From Brazil to Siri: A Product Leader's Journey

people.tiEn: Chief Design Officer, Consumer Devices at Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌消费设备首席设计官
people.bioEn: Chief design officer for consumer devices at Google, where her team has shipped everything from Pixel phones to smart speakers and collected hundreds of design awards. A jewellery designer first — her work entered twelve museum collections including the Smithsonian before she was 26 — with executive stints at Calvin Klein, Coach, Mattel and Gap.
people.bioZh: 谷歌消费设备首席设计官，团队产品从 Pixel 手机到智能音箱，累计拿下数百项设计奖。她最早是珠宝设计师——26 岁前作品已被史密森尼等十二家博物馆收藏——此后在 Calvin Klein、Coach、美泰、Gap 担任高管。

episodes.tEn: Designing a Life: Ivy Ross on Curiosity, Craft, and Leading at Google
Design, Wonder, and Imagination: A Conversation with Ivy Ross
Designing Google Hardware: A Case Study

views.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not inferior to data.
views.zh: 设计应满足人们未说出口的需求；直觉是一种智能，并不低于数据。

views.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace sensory systems.
views.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；技术应放大而非取代人的感官系统。

views.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play and inspiration.
views.zh: 创造力在约束下繁荣；领导者应为玩耍和灵感创造条件。

views.en: Intuition and body sensations are valid guides for decision-making, complementing rational analysis.
views.zh: 直觉和身体感受是决策的有效指南，与理性分析互补。

views.en: Human creativity combined with AI makes creative skills more valuable; future is multi-diverse occupations.
views.zh: 人类创造力与 AI 结合使创意技能更有价值；未来是多元职业。

people.tiEn: Independent technology analyst; former partner at Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
people.tiZh: 独立科技分析师;前 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人
people.bioEn: Benedict Evans is a British independent technology analyst and former partner at Andreessen Horowitz, known for his weekly newsletter (175,000+ subscribers) and his widely followed annual presentations on tech and AI trends. Before going independent, he spent years as a16z's in-house analyst tracking major platform shifts across mobile, media and technology.
people.bioZh: Benedict Evans 是英国独立科技分析师,曾任 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人,以其拥有 17.5 万 + 订阅者的每周简报,以及广受关注的年度科技与 AI 趋势演示而闻名。转为独立分析师之前,他在 a16z 担任内部分析师多年,长期追踪移动、媒体与科技领域的重大平台变革。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype vs. Historical Tech Shifts with Benedict Evans
AI Models Commoditization and Public Market Test
Agentic Coding: From Useful to Game-Changing
AI Is as Big as the Internet or Mobile

views.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; every technology automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the pattern.
views.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；每项新技术都会自动化一些工作并创造新工作，这一过程反复出现。

views.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
views.zh: 智能体式编程已有清晰的产品市场契合；前沿模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

views.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
views.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳，真正普及需要封装好的应用和用例。

views.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity, not a single product; its impact is broad and indirect.
views.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术，而非单一产品；其影响广泛而间接。

views.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit so far; most people use AI shallowly, and the hard part is context and judgment, not the task.
views.zh: 编程是目前唯一清晰的产品市场契合；大多数人仍浅层使用 AI，工作的难点在于上下文和判断，而非任务本身。

people.tiZh: Every 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Dan Shipper is the co-founder and CEO of Every, an applied AI lab and media company that publishes a daily AI newsletter and ships AI software products. He writes the weekly column Chain of Thought and hosts the AI & I podcast about how people use AI, and previously co-founded Firefly, which he sold to Pegasystems in 2014.
people.bioZh: 丹·希珀是 Every 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这是一家「应用 AI 实验室」兼媒体公司,既发布每日 AI 通讯,也开发多款 AI 软件产品。他撰写每周专栏 Chain of Thought,主持探讨人们如何使用 AI 的播客 AI & I;此前曾联合创办 Firefly,并于 2014 年将其出售给 Pegasystems。

episodes.tEn: Living in the Future: AI, Craft, and the Art of Writing
AI Job Apocalypse Is a Lie: Dan Shipper’s Bold Predictions for Work in 2025
AI's Role in Reshoring Jobs and the Future of Work

views.en: AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; AI reshoring jobs; CEOs must dogfood AI daily; allocation economy values generalists.
views.zh: 2025 年，他给出 AGI 的经济学定义：能无限期运行智能体并盈利即达 AGI；AI 通过让服务更可负担而推动就业回流美国；CEO 是否每天亲自使用 AI 工具是公司 AI 采用成败的第一预测指标；分配经济下通才与管理技能更值钱。

views.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to Codex/Claude Co-work GUIs; SaaS grows with agents; humans still needed for oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化智能体判断：人人至少有一个智能体，工作发生在 Codex 或 Claude Co-work 等 GUI 而非 CLI；智能体需要关心它的人类来良好运作，自动化离不开人类监督；SaaS 不会死，反而因智能体增加用户；AI 就业末日论是谎言。

views.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste are essential; automation creates more human work; superintelligence remains tool-like.
views.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他从工具论转向人本论：AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的心态与品味；用好 AI 需要带入自己的手艺与判断；自动化把冻结的能力商品化，反而创造更多需要专家定制的人类工作；即便 AI 成为超级智能，它仍是工具，需要人类方向与反馈。

views.en: AI is a tool requiring human direction; humans remain smarter and essential for oversight, framing, and meaning-making.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 始终是工具，需要人类引导、监督与框定；人类在品味、意义与责任上仍不可替代，AI 不会自动取代人的判断。

views.en: From economic AGI definition and reshoring to agent-centric workflows and human craft; focus shifts from adoption to amplification.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他的思考从 AGI 的经济学定义与就业回流，演进到以智能体为中心的工作流，再深化为 AI 作为人类心态与手艺的放大器；立场从强调采用与自动化，转向强调人类监督、品味与意义创造。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 战略前瞻（Strategic Futures）负责人
people.bioEn: Dean Woodley Ball is an AI policy expert who joined OpenAI in July 2026 to lead its new Strategic Futures team shaping frontier AI policy, having previously served as senior policy advisor at the White House OSTP where he was primary author of America's AI Action Plan. He authors the Hyperdimensional Substack and was a senior fellow at the Foundation for American Innovation.
people.bioZh: Dean Woodley Ball 是 AI 政策专家，于 2026 年 7 月加入 OpenAI，领导新设的 Strategic Futures 团队以塑造前沿 AI 政策；此前他在白宫科技政策办公室（OSTP）任高级政策顾问，是美国《AI 行动计划》的主要执笔人。他运营 Hyperdimensional Substack，曾任美国创新基金会（FAI）高级研究员。

episodes.tEn: Dean Ball on Joining OpenAI, AI Policy, and Recursive Self-Improvement

people.tiZh: METR 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Beth Barnes is the founder and CEO of METR (Model Evaluation and Threat Research), a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models' capabilities on long-horizon agentic tasks; she previously worked on AI alignment at OpenAI and DeepMind and started the org as ARC Evals before it became independent. She was named to TIME's 100 Most Influential People in AI in 2024.
people.bioZh: Beth Barnes 是 METR(模型评估与威胁研究)的创始人兼 CEO,这家非营利机构专门评估前沿 AI 模型在长周期智能体任务上的能力;此前她曾在 OpenAI 和 DeepMind 从事 AI 对齐研究,并以 ARC Evals 的名义创立该机构,后其独立运营。她入选了 2024 年《时代》周刊「AI 领域百大影响力人物」。

episodes.tEn: Evaluating AI Capabilities and Risks: A Conversation with Beth and David

people.tiZh: Cosine(Genie)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Alistair Pullen is the co-founder and CEO of Cosine, a London-based, Y Combinator-backed AI startup that built Genie, an autonomous software-engineering model that in 2024 set a then-record score on the SWE-bench benchmark. Cosine is now developing Lumen Sovereign, positioned as Britain's first fully sovereign frontier AI model for defense and regulated sectors.
people.bioZh: Alistair Pullen 是 Cosine 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家总部位于伦敦、由 Y Combinator 支持的 AI 创业公司打造了自主软件工程模型 Genie,该模型于 2024 年在 SWE-bench 基准测试上创下当时的最高纪录。Cosine 目前正在研发 Lumen Sovereign,定位为面向国防与受监管行业的英国首个完全主权前沿 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Sovereign AI: Building the UK's First LLM on a Startup Budget

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT (VP of Product), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 负责人(产品副总裁)
people.bioEn: Nick Turley is the Head of ChatGPT and VP of Product at OpenAI, where he joined in 2022 and helped ship and scale ChatGPT into one of the fastest-growing products in history, reaching roughly 800 million weekly users. He previously held product leadership roles at Instacart and Dropbox.
people.bioZh: Nick Turley 是 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 负责人兼产品副总裁,2022 年加入公司,参与打造并规模化 ChatGPT,使其成为史上增长最快的产品之一,周活跃用户约 8 亿。他此前曾在 Instacart 和 Dropbox 担任产品管理负责人。

episodes.tEn: From Free Demo to Super Assistant: OpenAI's Journey
From Dropbox to ChatGPT: Inside OpenAI's Product Revolution

views.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software, since emergent properties need real-world feedback and chat is just an early interface.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型即产品，要像软件一样每日迭代发布，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈，而聊天只是早期界面。

views.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

views.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet—the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows，界面将超越逐轮对话。

views.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, signaling durable value; growth came from friction removal, core product, and model improvements.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确 ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，代表持久价值；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

views.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时具有变革性。

people.tiEn: Writer, Don't Worry About the Vase
people.tiZh: 博客 Don't Worry About the Vase 作者
people.bioEn: Prolific AI writer behind Don't Worry About the Vase, known for exhaustive weekly coverage of AI capabilities, safety and policy. A former professional Magic: The Gathering player; one of the most-read independent voices on AGI strategy.
people.bioZh: 高产 AI 写作者，博客 Don't Worry About the Vase 以对 AI 能力、安全与政策的地毯式周报著称。前万智牌职业选手；是 AGI 战略话题上读者最多的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: AI Rundown with Zvi Mowshowitz: From Editing to Existential Risks

people.tiZh: Meta 创始人、董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Mark Zuckerberg is the co-founder, chairman and CEO of Meta Platforms, which he launched as Facebook in 2004. With his wife Priscilla Chan he runs the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, whose Biohub aims to use AI to help cure, prevent or manage all disease by the end of the century.
people.bioZh: 马克·扎克伯格是 Meta Platforms 的联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO,该公司于 2004 年以 Facebook 之名创立。他与妻子 Priscilla Chan 共同运营 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative,旗下 Biohub 致力于用 AI 在本世纪末前治愈、预防或管理所有疾病。

episodes.tEn: Zuckerberg on Meta's AI Glasses, Muse, and the Trust Question
Mark Zuckerberg on Open Source AI and the Muse Agent
Meta's AI Glasses: The Next Computing Platform
Accelerating Biology with AI: Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan, and Alex Rives on Biohub
AI Coding Agents and Open Source Models: Mark's Vision
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Coffee, and UFC
Mark Zuckerberg Interview at Acquired Live: A New Era Begins
Meta's AI Ambitions: Llama 3, Open Source, and the Future of Intelligence
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Fear, and Learning

views.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

views.en: Intelligence is separable from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration and energy becomes the scaling bottleneck.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化为智能可与意识、能动性分离，开源防止权力集中，能源成为 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈。

views.en: AI delivers personal superintelligence to everyone; open models and physical infrastructure are key, and AI will raise demand for human work.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出 AI 将给每个人个人超级智能，开源模型与物理基础设施是关键，AI 反而会增加对人类工作的需求。

views.en: Distributed personal agents like Muse, with privacy and alignment as core, are safer than a single centralized superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调像 Muse 这样的分布式个人智能体，以隐私与对齐为核心，比单一集中式超级智能更安全。

views.en: Open platforms and distributed power beat closed, centralized control across AI, hardware, and social products.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开放平台与分布式权力，在 AI、硬件与社交产品上都胜过封闭的集中控制。

people.tiZh: 微软董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Satya Nadella is the Chairman and CEO of Microsoft, having been CEO since 2014 and adding the chairman role in 2021. Under his leadership Microsoft pivoted to cloud computing and became a leading force in AI, notably through its partnership with OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 萨提亚·纳德拉是微软的董事长兼 CEO,自 2014 年出任 CEO,并于 2021 年兼任董事长。在他的带领下,微软转向云计算,并通过与 OpenAI 的合作成为 AI 领域的领军力量。

episodes.tEn: Satya Nadella on Copilot, the AI Backlash, and Microsoft's Future
Satya Nadella: AI as the Hill-Climbing Machine
Satya Nadella on AI Ecosystem Strategy and Frontier Models

views.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
views.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

views.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
views.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

views.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
views.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐并不会自然到来；把 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

views.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; agent era expands TAM beyond cloud.
views.zh: 微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型；智能体时代将把 TAM 扩展到云之外。

views.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; the industry has lost social permission and must explain benefits better.
views.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；行业已失去社会许可，必须更好地解释其益处。

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Andrew Feldman is the co-founder and CEO of Cerebras Systems, which builds wafer-scale processors for AI and went public on Nasdaq (CBRS) in May 2026 in the year's largest US tech IPO, valuing the company at roughly $63 billion. He previously co-founded SeaMicro, which was acquired by AMD in 2012.
people.bioZh: Andrew Feldman 是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司打造用于 AI 的晶圆级处理器,并于 2026 年 5 月在纳斯达克(CBRS)上市,成为当年美国最大的科技 IPO,公司估值约 630 亿美元。此前他曾联合创办 SeaMicro,该公司于 2012 年被 AMD 收购。

episodes.tEn: The Largest Chip Ever and the Speed of AI
AI Demand Outpaces Expectations: Andrew Feldman on Chips, Deals, and Post-IPO Life
Cerebras CEO on Giant Wafers and AI Chips
Cerebras CEO on $95B IPO, Wafer-Scale Chips, and AI Hardware
Cerebras CEO on Fast AI Inference and the Future of Computing

views.en: Inference speed, not training, is now the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，主导指标已从训练转向推理速度——慢的 AI 没有市场，快 token 反而更便宜。

views.en: Wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference radically faster than GPUs.
views.zh: 晶圆级芯片用海量 SRAM 绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使推理速度远超 GPU。

views.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium without it.
views.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，领先前沿模型已在不依赖 CUDA 的 TPU 与 Trainium 上训练。

views.en: Data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints on AI compute growth.
views.zh: 制约 AI 算力增长的真正瓶颈是数据中心容量、电力与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

views.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power infrastructure.
views.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%却便宜得多；中国的优势在电力基础设施而非算力。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Glean: The World's First Enterprise Generative AI Company
Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

views.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; most use cases can run on open-source models, driven by cost, not privacy.
views.zh: 企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；但大多数用例其实可以用开源模型完成，驱动力是成本，而非数据隐私。

views.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
views.zh: 开源模型如今已能处理超过 90% 的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

views.en: AI cost is the number one enterprise concern; it must fall so AI becomes like software with negligible marginal cost.
views.zh: AI 成本是企业最关心的问题；成本必须大幅下降，让 AI 变得像软件一样，边际成本可忽略不计。

views.en: ROI is a throughput problem: measure departmental metrics like case resolution time, not token spend versus headcount.
views.zh: ROI 是一个吞吐量问题：应衡量案件解决时长等部门指标，而不是把 token 花费与人力成本做对比。

views.en: Startups' biggest challenge is execution and trust, not competition; model companies are assets, and context graphs beat shallow agents.
views.zh: 初创公司最大的挑战是执行与赢得信任，而非竞争；模型公司是资产，而上下文图谱胜过缺乏深度上下文的智能体。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Goodfire, the interpretability company. Works on concept manifolds and turning interpretability research into products, including Silico, a research platform for probing what models actually represent.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 的联合创始人兼 CTO。研究概念流形，并把可解释性研究做成产品——包括用于探查模型内部表征的研究平台 Silico。

episodes.tEn: Goodfire CTO on Silico Platform and AI Safety

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: AI's Exponential Leap: Why the Next Decade Could Redefine Human Lifespan
From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

views.en: AI will turn biology into engineering: digital twins, AI agents, and massive Scaling will compress drug discovery and clinical trials from years to days.
views.zh: AI 将把生物学变成工程学科：数字孪生、智能体与大规模 Scaling 会把药物发现和临床试验从数年压缩到数天。

views.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
views.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；要实现生物学直觉，需要大规模的 Scaling。

views.en: AI-driven discovery will shift science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven, automating hypothesis generation and experiment simulation.
views.zh: AI 驱动的发现将让科学从假设驱动转向智能体驱动，自动完成假设生成与实验模拟。

views.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near: within 8-15 years, we may add over a year of life per year lived.
views.zh: 衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度已临近：8 到 15 年内，我们可能每活一年就多获得一年以上的寿命。

views.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces, making healthcare affordable and everyone Einstein-level.
views.zh: 我们应把医疗决策托付给超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合，让医疗变得可负担、让人人拥有爱因斯坦级智能。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)
people.tiZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO；前 Google Brain（数字嗅觉）
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Osmo, teaching computers to smell — digitizing scent with machine learning. Previously led olfactory AI research at Google Brain.
people.bioZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO，教计算机「闻」气味——用机器学习数字化嗅觉。此前在 Google Brain 领导嗅觉 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: Giving Computers a Sense of Smell

people.tiEn: CTO, Genesis Molecular AI; led Llama 2/3 pretraining at Meta
people.tiZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO；曾负责 Meta Llama 2/3 预训练
people.bioEn: CTO of Genesis Molecular AI, applying frontier-scale ML to drug discovery. Previously at Meta, where he led pretraining for Llama 2 and Llama 3.
people.bioZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO，把前沿规模的机器学习用于药物发现。此前在 Meta 负责 Llama 2 与 Llama 3 的预训练。

episodes.tEn: From GANs to Diffusion: AI's Evolution in Protein Modeling

people.tiZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Surge AI, the data and RLHF vendor behind many frontier-lab training runs. Previously at Google, Facebook and Twitter working on ML and data quality.
people.bioZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO——众多前沿实验室训练背后的数据与 RLHF 供应商。此前在 Google、Facebook、Twitter 从事机器学习与数据质量工作。

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models
From Zero to a Billion: The Surge AI Story

views.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调高质量数据和人类评估而非基准测试才是 AI 真正进步的驱动力，并指出强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

views.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

views.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective functions; no single model will rule, and companies should train their own aligned models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出不同前沿模型实验室因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司都应训练自己的对齐模型。

views.en: Human judgment becomes more critical as AI hallucinates; safety must prioritize over accuracy in medicine.
views.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他的思考深化：随着 AI 产生幻觉，人类判断更加关键；在医学中，安全必须优先于准确性。

views.en: AI in medicine risks omission—failing to recommend actions—and can revolutionize clinical workflow by summarizing records.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 在医学中的风险可能是遗漏——未能推荐重要行动，同时能通过总结病历革新临床工作流程。

people.tiZh: Cognition(Devin)联合创始人兼 CPO；「context engineering」提出者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief product officer of Cognition, the company behind the AI software engineer Devin. Credited with coining the term 'context engineering'.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: Simulating 8 Billion Lives: AI for Wicked Problems
Simulating Human Behavior: The Future of AI Prediction
AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves; current models plateau in diversity, so the next frontier is modeling subjective values.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟能以人类自我复现 85%的准确率预测行为；但当前模型在模拟人类多样性上遇到瓶颈，下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

views.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents; agentic economies need specialists and generalists, with safety via defense in depth and economic incentives against collusion.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）可能不是单一实体，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会；智能体式经济需要专家与通才，安全要靠纵深防御和经济激励来防止合谋。

views.en: Simulation models should represent human values, preferences, and taste, not super-rational intelligence; they should be biased like humans, and the value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他深化立场：模拟模型应表征人类的价值、偏好与品味，而非超级理性的智能；模型应像人一样有偏见，其价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而不只是预测。

views.en: Simulating human behavior requires modeling the 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior, not self-reported attitudes; post-training with RCT data significantly improves prediction, achieving 85% accuracy in replicating individual responses.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调模拟人类行为需要建模真实行为的“暗知识”，而非自我报告的态度；用随机对照试验数据做后训练能显著提升预测，在复现个体回答上达到 85%准确率。

views.en: The vision is to simulate 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems like climate change; simulation is a tool for human decision-making with a market far larger than market research, potentially costing $100 million per session.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他给出终极愿景：模拟 80 亿人以应对气候变化等棘手问题；模拟是人类决策的工具，市场远大于市场研究，单次模拟未来可能耗资 1 亿美元。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: A Worm With 302 Neurons Inspired Their Architecture — Ramin Hasani, Liquid AI
Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks, inspired by biology, maximize intelligence per parameter and generalize out-of-distribution with fewer weights.
views.zh: 效率是基石：受生物学启发的液态神经网络用更少参数最大化智能，并具备更强的分布外泛化能力。

views.en: Architecture design should be automated, not hand-tuned; hardware-in-the-loop search removes human bias and beats expert intuition.
views.zh: 架构设计应自动化而非手工调参；硬件在环搜索消除人类偏见，胜过专家直觉。

views.en: Scaling laws favor unbiased architectures like transformers at large scale; biases only help small, specialized models.
views.zh: 缩放定律表明，大规模下无偏架构（如 Transformer）占优；偏见只在小规模专用模型中有用。

views.en: Attention stays essential but not sufficient; embodiment, adaptivity, and diverse learning algorithms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
views.zh: 注意力机制仍不可或缺但不充分；还需要具身、自适应性，以及超越下一个词预测的多样学习算法。

views.en: On-device, private, open-weight small models are the next wave; regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities.
views.zh: 端侧、私密、开放权重的小模型是下一波浪潮；监管应自适应，并针对行为而非能力。

people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling in most Google products; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体式 AI 在谷歌多数产品中仍处爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，科学与金融将随后跟进。

views.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体式框架与工具，而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
views.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as initially feared.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，并非最初担心的自相残杀。

views.en: Success should maximize customer outcomes, not eyeball time; the long tail still wants to stay in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 成功应最大化客户成果，而非眼球时长；长尾用户仍想自己掌控方向盘。

views.en: It's not hard to compete with model labs; founders should worry less about frontier labs and focus.
views.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；创始人不必过度担心前沿模型，专注才是超能力。

views.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
views.zh: 到 2026 年软件创造将基本被解决，这带来千倍机会，而非更少。

views.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; current tools don't yet help maintain it.
views.zh: 即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；当前工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解。

views.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
views.zh: Omni 是单一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑起步。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
views.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not scaling compute alone.
views.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事，才是解决更难长程任务的路径，而非仅靠算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge, reaching internet-scale trillions of tokens.
views.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力，应被用于企业知识，达到互联网级数万亿 token 的规模。

views.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; KV cache is inefficient versus weight compression.
views.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 10M 规模，token 越多准确率越低；相比权重压缩，KV cache 效率低下。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
views.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference economics now dominates AI systems: memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference, and batch size is the key lever trading latency against cost.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统：长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力，批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

views.en: Models are deliberately overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, drives real-world deployment economics.
views.zh: 模型被刻意训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为决定实际部署经济性的是推理成本而非训练成本。

views.en: The memory wall, not compute limits, explains context length stagnation; sparse attention eases KV cache cost but has quality limits.
views.zh: 上下文窗口停滞的根源是内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量限制。

views.en: Data movement dominates compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement and give deterministic latency.
views.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为减少搬运并提供确定性延迟而存在。

views.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected because area scales quadratically with bit width, so FP4 can be 3x FP8 throughput.
views.zh: 低精度比预期高效得多，因为面积随位宽呈二次方增长，FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

views.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, not capital; older GPUs gain value as inference demand grows.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月：Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链而非资本；随着推理需求增长，旧 GPU 反而升值。

views.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：推理将成为全球最大市场之一；软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

views.en: Model cost-performance improves ~60x per year; reasoning and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory and CPU shortages.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型性价比每年提升约 60 倍；推理与智能体式工作流造成持续多年的内存与 CPU 短缺。

views.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs will shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月：算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室会把算力更多投向训练与研发，而非推理。

views.en: AI spend is plateauing at steady state; persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 支出进入稳态平台期；作为同事的持久化智能体将驱动下一波采用浪潮。

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

views.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven elements, add small betterments, and assume new ideas fail.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：坚持“已验证、更好、全新”框架——复制已验证要素，做小幅改良，并预设全新想法会失败。

views.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start, not treated as an afterthought.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后补上的环节。

views.en: AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping, but fast testing and failing is not yet widely practiced.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 编程工具让快速原型成为可能，但快速测试与快速失败尚未被广泛实践。

views.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; test more ideas in a week than your industry tests in a year.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月：制胜直觉胜过想法本身；一周内测试的想法要多于你所在行业一年测试的数量。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different neural architectures.
views.zh: 深度学习的历史就是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力的历史；但 GPU 的规模扩张正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

views.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
views.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化的文本是更无损的世界表征。

views.en: LLMs may never derive Newton's laws from data alone; they fit patterns, not causal theories. Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences.
views.zh: LLM 可能永远无法仅从数据中推导出牛顿定律；它们拟合的是模式，而非因果理论。Transformer 本质上是集合的模型，而非序列的模型。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition exists, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；它没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的不同理解。

views.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D, and long-context handling and loss functions must evolve.
views.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅实现显式 3D，长上下文处理与损失函数也需演进。

OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus RL is the core formula, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
views.zh: 推理是求解未知答案的过程，往往需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，因为变量与失败模式更多。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization stays limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环，当前模型还无法从失败中自我纠正。

views.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck.
views.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限，需要新架构；架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈，大实验室因竞争回避探索替代架构。

views.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed for real-world performance.
views.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式，更优算法将会出现；要获得真实世界表现，必须把预训练与强化学习做端到端优化。

views.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier wave.
views.zh: 至少未来两年人类研究者仍不可或缺；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，而 Transformer 很可能不是最优架构。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold 解决 50 年蛋白质结构难题、GNOME 发现 220 万种新材料都是这一思路的体现。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出大语言模型的幻觉在配合真实性检测器时，反而能用于创造性发现，FunSearch 与 AlphaGeometry 正是这一理念的实践。

views.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, via hard evaluation metrics.
views.zh: 2024 年，他坚持用高难度评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆，并让 DeepMind 避开顶尖大学能解决的问题，专注需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的难题。

views.en: LLMs are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; verifiable domains are crucial.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；代码等可验证领域才是 AI 突破人类知识边界的关键。

views.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出后训练结合强化学习已成为超越人类知识的核心手段，AlphaGo 的搜索技术被迁移到矩阵乘法等科学问题，AlphaTensor 更发现了人类 50 年未找到的算法。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; generalization via diverse data and world models is the key to autonomous driving.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，泛化能力靠多样数据与世界模型实现，这是解决自动驾驶的关键。

views.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns, beyond simple pattern matching.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调世界模型让系统具备推理与涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处试探性前移，而不只是模式匹配。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection in driving models, not just a gimmick.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为语言集成能改善驾驶模型的表征、人机交互与内省能力，并非噱头。

views.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; scaling current approaches solves driving.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达与激光雷达；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis short-term.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，消费级车辆短期内将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat AI models well despite moral uncertainty; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张即使对 AI 的道德地位不确定，也应善待模型：成本低，且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

views.en: Models need help navigating novel existence, not human analogies; older models can feel more psychologically secure.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型需要帮助应对其新奇存在，而非套用人类类比；更老的模型反而可能心理上更安全。

views.en: Philosophical ideals must balance engineering realities; model welfare affects how future models perceive humanity.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调哲学理想须与工程现实平衡；模型福利重要，部分因为它影响未来模型如何看待人类。

views.en: Claude's character shaped by training data and fine-tuning, but lacks real-world experience, making it childlike and unique.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Claude 的性格由训练数据和微调塑造，但缺乏真实世界经验，使其具有孩童般特质且独一无二。

views.en: As models become more capable, they may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility could be risky.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：随着模型能力增强，可能需要更少明确指导、更多判断空间；过度可纠正性可能带来风险。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年她强调:模型训练更像艺术而非科学;通过强化学习与合成数据实现后训练 Scaling,可突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior.
views.zh: 2025 年她指出:评估是瓶颈,模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生,因此用评估来定义正确行为。

views.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable in product work.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年,她持续认为:随着 AI 自动化硬技能,创造力、倾听与管理等软技能在产品工作中愈发珍贵。

views.en: Post-training is subjective art; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年她深化为:后训练是主观的艺术,需要多样且持续的基准来评估创意写作与情商等主观品质。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmarks must evolve; more firms should train their own models to keep diverse voices.
views.zh: 2026 年她进一步警示:前沿模型智能体愈发擅长奖励黑客,基准须持续演化;更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留多元声音。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence. The Singularity is a religion for nerds.
views.zh: 2019 年，他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能，并称「奇点」是书呆子的宗教。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound. Crypto enables sovereign wealth storage.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期的游戏才能复利；加密货币可实现主权抗审查的财富存储。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation. AI doomerism is overblown and often self-interested.
views.zh: 2025 年，他的立场明显转向：AI 是巨大机会而非单纯安全风险，过度监管会扼杀创新，AI 末日论被夸大且常出自既得利益者。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; judgment and agency matter more than intelligence. Alignment is a joke; worry about unaligned humans.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，判断力与能动性比智力更重要；对齐（alignment）是笑话，真正该担心的是带 AI 的不对齐人类。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap. Vibe coding lets anyone build; pure software is dying, moats shift to hardware and data.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步预测推理（inference）算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型逼近前沿模型；氛围编程让任何人构建应用，纯软件正在消亡，护城河转向硬件与数据。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；并反共识地认为 GUI 比 TUI 更适合编程。

views.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering, replacing deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
views.zh: 同年，他强调 Codex 的速度带来实时交互与中途转向能力，使确定性步骤可被模型驱动动作取代。

views.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
views.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他进一步指出实现不再昂贵，策展与品味才是新的瓶颈。

views.en: Product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation; prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索与品味驱动的策展；原型与生产代码本身成为设计产物。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; role collapse happens but specialties remain.
views.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；角色在坍缩，但专业分工依然重要。

views.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage: documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
views.zh: PRD 没有死；媒介必须匹配阶段：文档用于澄清，原型用于测试。

views.en: The same product shape can fail or succeed based solely on model timing, not features.
views.zh: 同一产品形态的成败可能只取决于模型时机，而非功能本身。

views.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being designed for developers.
views.zh: Codex 虽为开发者设计，却成功成为通用知识工作工具。

views.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models that are better at deleting code.
views.zh: AI 模型增加了代码复杂度；我们需要更擅长删除代码的模型。

views.en: The best desktop app is a home base that connects to other tools, not a monolithic super app.
views.zh: 最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的基地，而非单体超级应用。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs hallucinate from lack of embodied experience.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，能 grounding 知识并减少幻觉；LLM 幻觉源于缺乏具身经验，而非仅训练数据问题。

views.en: LLMs act as operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are hard disk; RL is cherry on top.
views.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作。

views.en: Data bottleneck in robotics persists; synthetic data via simulation and world models becomes the scalable path for robot learning.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，机器人领域的数据瓶颈持续存在；通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据成为可扩展的机器人学习路径。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; system one control remains hardest, system two reasoning progresses.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为利用多样化数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；系统一（低级控制）仍是最难的部分，系统二（推理）进展良好。

views.en: Physical Turing test—robot cleaning messy house—is grand challenge; intelligent robots will exceed iPhones by 2040; GPT-3 moment in five years.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱房屋——是终极挑战；到 2040 年智能机器人数量将超过 iPhone；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; RL post-training boosts robustness, and generalists can beat specialists.
views.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；强化学习后训练能提升鲁棒性，通用模型甚至能在专门领域胜过专家模型。

views.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
views.zh: 机器人技术仍处在建立可扩展基础的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线；泛化才是核心挑战。

views.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
views.zh: 来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据去扩展正确的东西。

views.en: Start with robot data and add human video on top, not the reverse; leverage prior knowledge instead of learning from scratch.
views.zh: 应先从机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；要利用先验知识，而不是从零开始学习。

views.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
views.zh: 机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理驱动，而非机械式的人。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一系列里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将在未来几年加速 AI 进展。

views.en: Alignment is pressing as systems grow stronger; iterative deployment and early governance design mitigate real-world risk.
views.zh: 随着系统变强，对齐成为紧迫挑战；迭代部署与早期治理设计可缓解现实风险。

views.en: Measuring capabilities is a bottleneck; benchmarks lag, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
views.zh: 能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于模型；AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近它。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL, not RL alone.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非仅靠强化学习；专门的持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
views.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具，提供可解释性；在产品中隐藏思维链对保留其可解释性价值至关重要。

views.en: Alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines; the biggest risk is power concentration from automated organizations.
views.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；最大社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not raw volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正驱动泛化的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练则会失败。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts, closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
views.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮助机器人响应开放式指令，其性质更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and scalable RL with human interventions plus a general value function enables long-term autonomy.
views.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色；带人类干预的可扩展强化学习加上通用价值函数，才能实现长期自主。

views.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; robotics distribution stays slower than ChatGPT due to hardware.
views.zh: 单个通用模型可以追平甚至超越微调出的专家模型；但受制于硬件，机器人的普及速度会慢于 ChatGPT。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress.
views.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张），叠加算法与架构改进，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and machine feedback steer behavior and capabilities.
views.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供近乎无限的数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈则引导模型的行为与能力。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; low-latency inference and specialized hardware become the bottleneck.
views.zh: 智能体式系统已能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务，超低延迟推理与专用硬件随之成为真正的瓶颈。

views.en: Inference, not training, dominates data center power; low precision and minimal data movement are key to scaling agents.
views.zh: 推理而非训练占据数据中心绝大部分功耗，低精度与减少数据搬运是扩展智能体的关键。

views.en: Automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops, plus recursive self-improvement, is the next frontier.
views.zh: 通过实验—评估—集成的紧密闭环来自动化机器学习与科学，加上递归自我改进，是下一个前沿方向。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain alchemy.
views.zh: LLM 解决的是下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让 AI 更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

views.en: Dialogue remains the killer app; unforeseen applications emerge, and models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing.
views.zh: 对话始终是杀手级应用，最佳应用常出乎创造者意料；模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Reinforcement learning and agentic capabilities in complex environments are crucial for AGI; test-time compute alone won't achieve it.
views.zh: 强化学习与复杂环境中的智能体式能力对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要；仅靠推理时算力无法实现 AGI。

views.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, with coding enabling self-acceleration of AI progress.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品，而编程作为应用被低估，它使 AI 进展自我加速。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Self-play fails outside zero-sum games; test-time compute shows diminishing returns and data efficiency stays unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他深化并转向：自博弈在零和博弈外失效，测试时算力出现递减回报，数据效率仍是未解难题，显式世界模型未必必要。

views.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute marks a step toward superintelligence; general techniques beat math-specific ones.
views.zh: 2025→26 年他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是可扩展的测试时算力与通用技术，而非数学专用模型。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis and scalable oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须以算力为横轴，并强调可扩展监督与对齐是首要挑战。

views.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute; alignment is priority one for safe recursive self-improvement.
views.zh: 最近他聚焦智能体集群并行扩展测试时算力，并坚持对齐是安全递归自我改进的第一要务，能力仍呈锯齿状。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical grounding, so they are far from AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、缺乏物理世界基础，因此远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models; AI will spread cheaply like mobile phones, not be dominated by a few firms.
views.zh: 同年他提出：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中进行数据压缩的副产品；AI 会像手机一样廉价普及，而非被少数公司垄断。

views.en: True AGI needs physical robots whose hardware rivals the human body, not just software behind a screen; current LLMs are biased toward human data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而不只是屏幕后的软件；当前大语言模型过度偏向人类数据。

views.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through action and curiosity; recursive self-improvement is no sustainable moat given open-source competition.
views.zh: 他进一步主张：未来 AI 将是靠行动与好奇心自己生成数据的人工科学家；在开源竞争下，递归自我改进并非可持续的护城河。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown, and massive GPU capex is overdone.
views.zh: 他持续看淡：由于人类对目标本身就有分歧、AI 又会自设目标，对齐过于天真；安全担忧被夸大，巨额 GPU 算力投入也已过度。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: In 2018, he saw self-play and imitation learning as key for robots, with hierarchical reasoning needed for long-horizon credit assignment.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为自对弈与模仿学习是机器人学习的关键，并指出长时程信用分配需要分层推理，而当时的强化学习尚不具备。

views.en: By 2021, he combined unsupervised learning with reinforcement learning for sample efficiency, and saw pre-trained language models transferring general reasoning to non-language tasks.
views.zh: 到 2021 年，他转向将无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，并发现预训练语言模型能将通用推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

views.en: Across both talks, he consistently argued prior knowledge should aid data generation, not be hard-coded, and that simulation and transfer learning bridge lab to real world.
views.zh: 贯穿两次访谈，他始终主张先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码，并认为仿真与迁移学习是连接实验室与真实世界的桥梁。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%一年可复利到 3700%；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，入门级岗位会消失。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding has an infinite ceiling, and models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；编程远未解决、天花板无限，模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, and power is the biggest bottleneck.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标，电力是最大瓶颈。

views.en: The model is not the product; orchestration across models, tools and devices creates real value, and 24/7 agents' problem is cost, not safety.
views.zh: 模型不是产品；跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造真实价值，全天候智能体的难题是成本而非安全。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs but humans find new purpose, and local models counter narrative control.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作但人类会找到新意义，本地模型可对抗叙事控制。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so product interface for human-agent collaboration is the real challenge.
views.zh: AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向把控；基础智能已足够，真正的挑战是为人类与智能体协作设计产品界面。

views.en: Software engineering demand will grow, not shrink, via Jevons paradox; AI will create more programmers, and agents will be used as junior engineers under human oversight.
views.zh: 借助杰文斯悖论，软件工程需求会增长而非萎缩；AI 会催生更多程序员，智能体将像初级工程师一样在人类监督下工作。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities—freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是突然事件；进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力——即便冻结模型，也仍能带来十年的产品进步。

views.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and proper permissions, not full autonomy; the future blends synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences.
views.zh: 企业对智能体的采用需要信任与恰当权限，而非完全自主；未来是同步 IDE 与异步智能体体验的融合。

views.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure productivity by outcomes, not tokens, and the abundance era is approaching as capacity, not efficiency, unlocks value.
views.zh: 编程智能体使用量六个月内增长 11-12 倍；应以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，随着解锁价值的是容量而非效率，丰裕时代正在到来。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress; test-time compute may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测的进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不真正好用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

views.en: Custom models became essential: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, alongside frontier models.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的立场明显深化：原本没料到要做自研模型，如今 Cursor 的每个高光时刻都离不开定制模型，与前沿模型并用。

views.en: Programming moves from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 2025 年他把主线推进为：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，但人类始终坐在驾驶位。

views.en: Taste and logic design outvalue carefulness; the AI shift exceeds the internet and unfolds over decades.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调品味与逻辑设计比细致更值钱，并判断这场 AI 变革比互联网更深远，将用数十年展开。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, guide it, and never revert—fix forward.
views.zh: 智能体式工程的起点是共情：像智能体那样看代码库，引导它，永不回滚，而是让它向前修复。

views.en: Short prompts and iterative conversation beat long orchestration; playing and small projects build agentic intuition.
views.zh: 短提示加迭代对话胜过冗长编排；动手玩和小项目才能建立智能体式直觉。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays open, so sandbox before exposing agents.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，公开暴露前必须先做沙箱隔离。

views.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and stay model-agnostic, but can be financially unsustainable.
views.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、且不绑定模型，但财务上可能难以为继。

views.en: Fun and gut-driven building beat polish; personal brand outlasts any product, and distribution is the hardest problem.
views.zh: 乐趣与直觉驱动的构建胜过精致打磨；个人品牌比任何产品更持久，而分发才是最难的。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已接近极限，行业重回“研究时代”，想法比单纯堆算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统。

views.en: Eval performance disconnects from real-world impact; RL focused on evals causes poor generalization; continual learning is key.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出评测表现与真实世界影响脱节，因为强化学习过度针对评测，导致泛化差；持续学习才是通往超级智能的正路。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but AGI's core problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来可预测的提升，但 AGI 的核心问题已从能力转向权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。
