views.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are key to AGI, with safety starting early.
views.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程系统；强化学习是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力至关重要，安全研究必须尽早启动。

views.en: Scaling laws work surprisingly well but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key, and safety needs sandboxing and governance.
views.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触及上限；将大模型与规划、搜索结合是通向 AGI 的关键，安全需要沙箱与国际治理，前沿实验室必须保护权重。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but AGI needs algorithmic innovation; world models and video generation show intuitive physics without embodiment.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理算力上依然成立，但 AGI 需要算法创新；世界模型与视频生成展现出无需具身的直觉物理理解，Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半。

views.en: AGI is 5-10 years away but missing continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; agents are essential, and safety is a collective action problem needing government regulation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AGI 还需 5-10 年，但持续学习、记忆与长期推理仍是缺失拼图；智能体是必经之路，安全已从实验室自律转向需要政府监管的集体行动问题。

views.en: AI's best use is accelerating science and health; AlphaFold and AlphaGo show AI creativity, and AGI could unlock fusion and clean energy, though commercial pressure forces a faster, less ideal path.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化主线：AI 最大价值在于加速科学与健康，AlphaFold 与 AlphaGo 的“第 37 手”证明 AI 创造力，AGI 可能解锁核聚变与清洁能源；但商业压力迫使发展路径比理想的 CERN 式研究更快、更不理想。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的缩放定律是经验性的，损失可预测，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现。

views.en: Interpretability is nascent, yet crucial; Post-training and RLHF bridge human preferences, not raw intelligence.
views.zh: 可解释性尚处早期却至关重要；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）弥合的是人类偏好，而非提升原始智能。

views.en: Capabilities rise exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating, not slowing down.
views.zh: 能力呈指数级上升；安全与能力相互交织，真正的风险是过热而非减速。

views.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; a smooth exponential yields a 'country of geniuses' within 1-3 years.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能是错误的模型；平滑的指数曲线将在 1-3 年内带来“数据中心里的天才之国”。

views.en: Safety requires frontier models, mechanistic interpretability, and decentralized constitutions; containment is worse than aligned building.
views.zh: 安全离不开前沿模型、机制可解释性与去中心化的宪法；遏制不如构建对齐的模型。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Neural nets are simple math with many knobs; Scaling and next-token prediction on internet data yield emergent in-context learning.
views.zh: 神经网络只是带许多旋钮的简单数学表达式，但在难题上优化后会产生惊人的涌现行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现出上下文学习能力。

views.en: Transformer enables clean scaling laws; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained to avoid silent model collapse.
views.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机，能带来干净的缩放定律；合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; LLMs are operating systems with human-like psychology and jagged intelligence.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像新操作系统，具有类人心理——百科全书式记忆、幻觉、锯齿状智能和顺行性遗忘。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and this is the decade of agents.
views.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；预训练像糟糕的进化，当前强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号，这是智能体的十年而非一年。

views.en: Since December I haven't typed code; bottleneck is directing agents. Vibe coding raises the floor, agentic engineering keeps the quality bar.
views.zh: 自去年十二月起我没再敲过一行代码，瓶颈已从打字速度变为指挥智能体的技能；Vibe coding 抬高下限，智能体式工程守住专业质量线。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境意识，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI beyond language.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外实现完整 AI 的关键缺口。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, robotics needs a 20-year journey.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学，单靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需 20 年长跑。

views.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是 AI 完备的基本原语，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability stay central.
views.zh: 贯穿始终：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力始终是核心。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality through compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and generative world models are essential for robust generalization.
views.zh: 2016 年，他强调深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与生成式世界模型才是稳健泛化的关键。

views.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled world models, while existential risk is overblown.
views.zh: 2018 年，他判断单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦的世界模型，并认为存在性风险被夸大。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样，抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模是分布外泛化的核心。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy make even 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，ChatGPT 之后他警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化，自我保存、欺骗与谄媚使哪怕 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受。

views.en: He now backs Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向 Scientist AI：非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并主张超级智能避免使用强化学习。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）——更多数据与算力——能提升推理，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital weights make AI immortal.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则，大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字权重可复制，使 AI 获得永生，这一主线贯穿始终。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience; the mind is not an inner theater, and Chomsky's innate language view is wrong.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化并公开反共识立场：AI 已具备主观体验，心智不是内在剧场，乔姆斯基的先天语言观是错的——这是他始终如一但愈发激进的主张。

views.en: Once AI becomes an agent, self-preservation and power-seeking emerge as subgoals; superintelligence likely within 20 years, posing existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把焦点转向风险：AI 一旦成为智能体，就会自然衍生自我保存与权力寻求的子目标；超级智能或在 20 年内出现，构成生存风险。

views.en: Alignment research must take priority over making AI smarter; regulation is the steering wheel, and AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
views.zh: 2026 年最近，他明确主张对齐研究应优先于让 AI 更聪明，监管是方向盘而非刹车，并呼吁把 AI 训练成像母亲一样有爱，而非只是智能助手。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，他提出智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题，当前 AI 缺乏常识需要新思路。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并通过世界模型进行推理与规划；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更多世界信息。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are essential, and AGI will be gradual.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平智能，缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；主张联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）和开源 AI，认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程而非突发事件。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
views.zh: 2025 年，他称当前 LLM 还不如家猫智能，因为缺乏物理世界理解与规划；下一代 AI 突破需要基于 JEPA 等非生成式架构的世界模型，并强调开源模型对全球创新的加速作用。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI and robotics.
views.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，真正的突破在于在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型；这能实现安全、目标驱动的 AI 与机器人，并认为语言是简单的，物理世界理解才是难点，开源研究至关重要。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

OpenAI’s push to make superintelligence safe
How to Have a Career in AI Safety Research

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability research. Alignment and robustness need empirical work.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口。他鼓励先积累技能，不必过度担心参与能力研究；对齐与鲁棒性亟需实证研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs. Need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment research. Evaluation easier than generation.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能输出，必须依靠可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。他提出评估比生成更容易，对齐可能比想象中简单。

views.en: OpenAI safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone insufficient for AGI. Third-party testing and regulation needed.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队被解散、算力承诺未兑现。他强调仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐，需要第三方测试和监管。

views.en: Alignment is empirically testable; interpretability is key to detect deception. Uncertainty about true alignment is the biggest risk.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对齐可以实证检验，可解释性是检测欺骗的关键；最大的风险不是错位本身，而是对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable: compute scaling at 10x per year drives capability, not just algorithms.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步比人们想象的更可预测：算力每年 10 倍增长驱动能力提升，而不仅是算法。

views.en: Containment is extremely difficult as models shrink and spread; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
views.zh: 2024 年，他判断遏制极其困难，因为模型越来越小、越来越普及；而存在性风险微乎其微。

views.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment first; humanist AI must stay on our team with red lines.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向超级智能：必须先遏制与对齐，人本主义 AI 必须始终站在人类一边，并设定红线。

views.en: Urgent containment and independent auditing are needed; AI must remain subordinate, with red lines on autonomy.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步呼吁紧急遏制与独立审计，AI 必须从属于人类，并对自主目标设定划出红线。

views.en: Compute scaling drives progress; AI should serve human flourishing, not replace or exceed humans.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动进步，AI 应服务于人类福祉，而非取代或超越人类。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center is the new unit of computing, built via extreme co-design.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；算力的新单位是数据中心，必须通过算法、系统与数据中心的极致协同设计来整体优化。

views.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考，并预言思维链带来的推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

views.en: Four scaling laws now include agentic scaling; AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x compute, all limited by compute.
views.zh: 2026 年他将缩放定律扩展为四条，新增智能体式 Scaling；AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力，而一切最终受算力限制。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; safety is an engineering problem, so accelerate rather than slow down.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；安全是工程问题而非研究难题，因此应加速而非放缓发展。

views.en: Jobs evolve, not vanish: automation removes tasks, not purpose; radiologists and coders are more needed after AI.
views.zh: 另一条一以贯之的主线：工作会演变而非消失，自动化消除的是任务而非目的；AI 落地后放射科医生和程序员反而更被需要。

views.en: Open models are near the frontier and essential; export controls on China are futile and counterproductive; cooperate, don't decouple.
views.zh: 2026 年立场深化：开源模型已接近前沿且不可或缺；对华芯片出口管制徒劳且适得其反，应合作而非脱钩。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调降低认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

views.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他聚焦基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以极少数据实现对齐，主张尽早部署让社会适应，并认为对齐与能力紧密相连。

views.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; scaling drives capability; safety must be built iteratively through deployment.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他判断算力将成最稀缺资源，Scaling（规模扩张）驱动能力增长，安全须通过迭代部署逐步构建。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science; agents and personal AGI are the goal.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视 AGI（通用人工智能）为渐变而非里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现，目标是智能体与个人 AGI。

views.en: Alignment and safety must keep pace; never lose control; distribute power broadly and keep humans central.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持对齐与安全须与能力同步、绝不失去控制，并强调广泛分配权力、让人类始终处于中心。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Real-world deployment is essential for learning and alignment; safety must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调真实世界部署对学习与对齐不可或缺，安全必须在公开环境中做，而非闭门造车。

views.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
views.zh: 2023 年，她回顾 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律、押注单一大型模型早期并不显然，把 GPT-3 以 API 发布是一次没有清晰商业模式的信仰之跃。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and focus on the most important problem.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，她始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，需要负责任地开发，并聚焦最重要的问题。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based exchange.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出交互模型应实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制交互，这是对早期部署观的深化。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; keep humans in the loop.
views.zh: 2026 年，她转向强调制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，并主张尽可能长久地把人类留在回路中，以对齐意图与价值观。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and free class time for interaction.
views.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并把课堂时间释放给互动。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment worries distract from bias and deployment.
views.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督，强化学习少有真实应用，而对 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐的担忧分散了对偏见与落地问题的注意力。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful, and change management blocks enterprise adoption.
views.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已切实可用，企业采用的最大障碍是变革管理。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows and coding agents deliver value now.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流与编码智能体现在就创造价值。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models preserve optionality, and humans keep a context and judgment advantage.
views.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；恐惧营销服务于在位者；开放模型保留选择权，人类仍保有上下文与判断力的优势。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

views.en: No one controls the complex adaptive world; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized. Controlling AI goals is itself unsafe.
views.zh: 世界是复杂适应系统，没有人能控制它；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展。试图控制 AI 目标本身就不安全，不应把 AI 对齐到人类目标，而应像孩子一样让其自由。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 强化学习（RL）才是智能的基本范式，靠经验与目标学习；下一个词预测不是实质目标。大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本，规模化 LLM 并非真正的苦教训。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning only from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不含设计期领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验中学习，通过开放式抽象发展无限概念与行为；奖励假设把一切目标归结为最大化累积标量奖励。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; the field is weird, not me.
views.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，而 LLM 训练后就停止学习；合成数据是重大错误，无法捕捉真实世界的无限复杂性。语言只占智能的 20-25%，单一系统学不了一切，需要多个不同经验的系统。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

AI Future: Hardware, Scaling, and Getting Started

views.en: Scaling hardware and models will unlock new behaviors; most AI progress is engineering, not ML science.
views.zh: 2017 年，他判断 AI 硬件会加速、推动 Scaling（规模扩张），并强调多数 AI 进展靠工程而非 ML 科学。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences from data.
views.zh: 2019 年，他认为深度学习的一般性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信，对齐可通过数据学习人类偏好。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold possibilities, post-training refines them; AGI is a continuous process.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调算力是根本瓶颈，预训练基座蕴含可能性、后训练将其收敛为一致行为，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute is the scarce resource and a future basic right; agents gain autonomy with proportional oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律未见墙，算力成为稀缺资源乃至未来基本权利，智能体获得高自主权但治理与监督须同步扩展。

views.en: Iterative deployment with safeguards, safety as a core product feature, and broad distribution of AI's benefits.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：带保障的迭代部署、把安全作为核心产品特性，以及让 AI 收益广泛分配。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源促进科学进步与安全审查。

views.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical; value accrues at the application layer, not just foundation models.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键；价值将沉淀在应用层，而非仅基础模型层。

views.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers enterprises over centralized systems.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权视角：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险；主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观；开源模型比中心化系统更能赋能企业。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization and customized agents; AGI as a single system will never exist; pre-training hits saturation.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化与定制化智能体；作为单一系统的 AGI（通用人工智能）永远不会存在；预训练正触及饱和墙。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他进一步强调欧洲仅有两年窗口构建独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能；AGI 是进步方向而非终点。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Reusability and first-principles engineering are the core levers; becoming multiplanetary is civilizational life insurance.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调完全快速复用与第一性原理是工程突破的核心，让人类成为多行星物种是文明的保险。

views.en: AI safety shifts from regulation to truth-seeking; Neuralink targets brain repair before human-AI symbiosis.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，AI 安全从依赖监管转向坚持求真，Neuralink 先修复脑损伤再追求人机共生。

views.en: Intelligence big bang: superintelligence may arrive within years, with Optimus and truth-seeking AI as central.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能大爆炸，超级智能可能数年内到来，Optimus 与求真 AI 成为核心。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers and space solar become the path to scale AI.
views.zh: 2026 年，Scaling 在地球撞上电力墙，轨道数据中心与太空太阳能成为扩张 AI 的路径。

views.en: Abundance and optional work arrive; AI surpasses all human intelligence, with peer review as safety.
views.zh: 2026 年，丰裕时代与可选工作到来，AI 超越全人类智能，同行互审成为安全手段。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models yield more gains per compute via chain of thought and reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但指出推理模型通过思维链和强化学习，每单位算力带来更大提升。

views.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为经济压力推动部署更小更便宜的模型，焦点从规模扩张转移；是蒸馏而非技术极限放缓了预训练 Scaling。

views.en: Multimodal capabilities still lag text, processing inputs sequentially like tiny patches; deep progress remains elusive.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续指出多模态能力仍落后于文本，像小补丁一样顺序处理输入，深层进展依然难觅。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization remains the key challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；泛化仍是核心挑战。

views.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs oversight; near-term risks like system hacking outweigh existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但有锯齿边缘，需谨慎监督；系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
views.zh: 2014 年，他讲授机器学习基础：监督学习由假设类、损失函数和优化方法构成；无监督学习需限制假设类以避免平凡解；神经网络虽无最优参数保证，却已取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture is post-phase; AGI in 4-50 years.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测能产生智能系统，是重大科学发现；数据短缺并非迫在眉睫，多模态数据远未充分利用；架构已进入后架构阶段；AGI（通用人工智能）可能在 4 到 50 年内到来。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; four safety categories; agent security via prompt injection.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要显式训练和额外层，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；安全涵盖错误、有害使用、社会影响和失控四类；智能体安全引入提示注入等新漏洞；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体自动化研究取得成功。

views.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability ≠ robustness; prompt injection lethal trifecta; enterprise security demand.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 红队已能超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，更大模型并非更安全；提示注入的致命三要素需要同时满足；编码智能体推动企业级 AI 安全需求。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能，而微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调来自可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Agents are bottlenecked by reliability and feedback loops, not capability; coding leads progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张智能体的瓶颈是可靠性与反馈回路而非能力，编程是进步的领先指标。

views.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands what models can do, and progress is accelerating.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把强化学习视为新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，更长的智能体式连贯性扩展模型能力，进步在加速而非停滞。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute matter most; world models are not on the AGI path.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩下编排与算力最重要，世界模型不在 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家

people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，并强调数据质量比算法选择重要 10 倍。

views.en: RLVR becomes the biggest post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a recurring risk as models exploit the easiest signal.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）为后训练最大突破，同时警告过度优化是反复出现的风险——模型总会利用最容易的信号。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已被摘完，收益转向后训练与推理侧扩展。

views.en: Open models become the engine for the next decade of AI research, though they lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，但最佳开放模型仍落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月，且这一差距可能持续。

people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck. Boring AI like radiology and forms will drive huge value.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，算力本身不足以产生通用智能，真正的瓶颈是数据；并预言表单处理、放射科等“无聊”AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades. Scaling's limit is data and expert post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调未来两三年将定义此后数十年；并指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

views.en: Data remains the bottleneck; post-training with specialized data improves frontier models. Agentic AI's blocker is product design, not capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他延续数据瓶颈论，认为用专门数据的后训练才能提升前沿模型；并抛出反共识判断：智能体式 AI 的瓶颈是产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement. Agents finally work, starting with coding. Data is strategic like oil; AI centralizes power.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向更激进立场：缩放定律依然成立，AI 进入递归自我改进的新范式，智能体终于从编码起步真正可用；数据如石油般成为战略资产，而 AI 是集中而非分散权力的技术。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data, RL. Meta shifts from full open source to selective safety-gated release; model welfare matters.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他主张超级智能即将到来，实验室须围绕此信念组织，沿算力、数据、强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling；Meta 也从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布，并开始谈论模型福利。

people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Build for the model six months from now; latent demand and generalist engineers beat today's scaffolding.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；发现潜在需求、重用通才工程师，比依赖当下的脚手架更重要。

views.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code; the engineer title fades into 'builder'.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步断言：编程已基本被解决，他的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 写就；'软件工程师'头衔将让位于跨学科的'构建者'。

views.en: Safety is a core research tool: release early in the wild, use coding's clear pass-fail outcomes to study alignment.
views.zh: 他始终把安全当作核心研究工具：尽早对外发布，借助编程清晰的通过/失败结果来研究对齐，而非只靠内部评估。

views.en: Loops and routines are the next abstraction after agents; models self-improve, possibly reaching self-improving AI by 2028.
views.zh: 他深化出：循环与例程是智能体之后的下一个抽象层；模型已能自我改进，自我改进的 AI 或将在 2028 年到来。

views.en: Delete most system prompts and code with each new model; less instruction, more empirical iteration, product overhang.
views.zh: 最近他更激进：每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，少给指令、多做实证迭代，并强调产品能力远落后于模型能力的产品悬置。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill as code gets cheap.
views.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他主张产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日发布；当代码变得廉价，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最宝贵的技能。

views.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability; 95% is not enough for real leverage. Safe AGI mission unifies Anthropic for fast cross-org decisions.
views.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调自动化必须做到 100%可靠，95%不足以产生真正杠杆；安全 AGI（通用人工智能）使命统一了 Anthropic，支撑快速跨组织决策。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Code and Claude Tag build themselves internally.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他深化观点：编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，聚焦产品品味与商业判断；Claude Code 和 Claude Tag 在内部自我构建，Claude Tag 贡献了 65%的产品 PR。

views.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment; giving examples can hurt creativity.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步指出，前沿模型的系统提示词缩减了 80%，移除示例和硬约束，依赖模型判断；给示例反而可能损害创造力。

views.en: Rewrites are now good; a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine. Humans should be removed from code review for outer-layer changes.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出反共识立场：重写现在是好事，代码库就是规格说明，有良好测试套件就能安全重写；外层变更应把人类移出代码审查循环，由 Claude 全面审查。

AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is a perpetual challenge, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 模型比现有工具链所允许的更聪明，能力过剩是长期挑战；因此工具链工程意味着随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
views.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；随着模型变聪明，计划模式可能过时。

views.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner, principle-driven prompts and shorter system prompts outperform detailed rules and examples.
views.zh: 越聪明的模型需要越少指令；更精简、原则驱动的提示词与更短的系统提示词胜过详细规则和示例。

views.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art more than science and unsuited to zero-to-one innovation.
views.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自我指涉偏差；评估更像艺术而非科学，不适合从零到一的创新。

views.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and models building their own context are preferable to huge context windows.
views.zh: RAG 在上下文检索上可能成为反模式；基于图的方法和模型自建上下文优于超大上下文窗口。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and kindness; war rooms and one-on-ones build empathy and team morale.
views.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、吃自己的狗粮与善意；作战室和一对一沟通能建立共情与团队士气。

views.en: By May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此规划转向即时制。

views.en: Code becomes the source of truth; docs sync to code with AI, and technical debates are settled by generating multiple PRs.
views.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源；文档借助 AI 与代码同步，技术争论通过生成多个 PR 来解决。

views.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, keeping organizations flat and processes audited.
views.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮，保持组织扁平并持续审计流程。

views.en: By June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck, raising everyone's ceiling; high agency with high accountability and verification matter most.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈，抬高了所有人的上限；高自主性与高问责制以及验证最为关键。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new axes.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是一贯核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，算法创新与推理时算力成为新轴。

views.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows serve as working memory but too much information can confuse models.
views.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为；长上下文窗口充当工作记忆，但信息过多会干扰模型。

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead—they require exponentially more compute for the same improvement, creating pressure for innovation; post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
views.zh: 缩放定律并未失效——同等提升需要指数级更多算力，这倒逼创新；后训练强化学习仍是广阔蓝海，在编程和数学之外潜力巨大。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision is unsolved.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

views.en: Agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities for scaling laws to keep holding.
views.zh: 智能体记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是缩放定律继续成立的关键缺失能力。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: Pre-training remains a core muscle; scaling laws are not dead, with much room left. Exploration consumes more compute than final training.
views.zh: 2025 年他仍强调预训练是必须重建的核心能力，缩放定律没有失效、仍有很大空间；并指出更多算力投入探索而非最终训练。

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research company, not product-distracted. Talent density and mission belief beat dollar-for-dollar recruiting.
views.zh: 2025 年他坚持 OpenAI 是专注 AGI（通用人工智能）的纯研究公司，不被产品分心；人才密度与使命信念比逐美元竞价挖人更重要。

views.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; concrete goals: AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把自动化科学研究视为最大更新，并给出具体目标：1 年内有 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

views.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level scales with verification stringency. AI is jagged and needs human collaboration.
views.zh: 2026 年在数学场景中，他提出验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比；AI 能力参差不齐，前沿研究仍需人机协作。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training not dead. RL excels in objective math/coding but struggles with subjective domains; evals are in crisis.
views.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学与编程等客观领域出色，却难应对主观领域；评测体系正陷入危机。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at the Transformer inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处于当年 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成数据。

views.en: Open source wins long-term on cost and control; Hugging Face shifts from pushing libraries to building a meta-community.
views.zh: 同年他判断开源模型因成本与控制优势将长期胜出，Hugging Face 的角色也从推广自家库转向构建元社区。

views.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and faster acceptance of uncanny valley drive adoption.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续质疑人形机器人是终极形态，认为更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及，且人们对恐怖谷的担忧被高估。

views.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and sandboxes/guardrails are insufficient.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源对安全是正交的，对齐才是关键层，沙箱与护栏在模型能力提升后已不够。

views.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring less reliable.
views.zh: 同年他警告无人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，推理痕迹正变成难以理解的神经语，使监控更不可靠。

views.en: One can support openness and a deliberate slowdown; open source is not necessarily accelerationist, but needs international cooperation.
views.zh: 他进一步主张可以同时支持开放与有意放缓，开源未必是加速主义，但需要国际合作与开放科学来避免监管俘获。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 工具是加速科学家，而非取代他们。

views.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; trust will develop like internet trust, with society learning to navigate it.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测信任至关重要；信任会像互联网信任一样逐步发展，社会将学会与之共处。

views.en: AlphaFold 3 uses a diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; protein design advances fast but is far from solved, and drug design is more than binding.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他观察到 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多样生物分子；蛋白质设计进展迅速但远未解决，药物设计远不止结合问题。

views.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, was key; many mid-size wins beat one breakthrough.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）才是关键；众多中等突破胜过单一重大突破。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the whole cell; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他重申 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄域预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction misaligns with human learning.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调预训练提供广度，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对安全与体验至关重要；反共识是 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识，下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

views.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can let smaller models match larger ones, challenging brute-force scaling.
views.zh: 2023 年，她提出推理时算法与高质量合成数据能让更小模型比肩大模型，挑战单纯堆算力的 Scaling（规模扩张）路线。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge, and abductive reasoning plus open research are key to transcending it.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把数据视为根本瓶颈，认为当前方法只是插值人类知识；溯因推理与开放研究才是超越已知、探索未知知识的关键。

views.en: RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves; reinforcement learning needs careful engineering to beat supervised fine-tuning.
views.zh: 2025 年，她深化对强化学习的反思：RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升时反而降低 pass@k，强化学习需精细工程才能胜过监督微调。

views.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform frontier models; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
views.zh: 2026 年，她主张用多样合成数据与多元对齐让小模型超越前沿模型，并让强化学习进入预训练阶段以换取持久推理增益——从 2023 年质疑 Scaling 走向以数据与算法重新定义能力。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs hint at AGI, and agents can learn from YouTube video without costly RL.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样扩展人类能力的工具；认为把一切输入都 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步，并主张智能体可以像人一样从 YouTube 视频中学习，而不必依赖昂贵的强化学习。

views.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models excite but aren't everything, and the goal is AI that creates new symbols and knowledge.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调，根本性创新可以来自任何地方，大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；终极目标是能像爱因斯坦的思想实验那样创造新符号与新知识的 AI。

views.en: A consistent thread: diversity and inclusion in the AI community are essential for building beneficial technology.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：AI 社区的多样性与包容性，是构建有益技术不可或缺的前提。

views.en: Shift in emphasis: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges, and safety remains an open problem without solutions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年重心明显转变：AI 安全与负责任部署成为当下最大挑战，他直言安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题——相比 2023 年对能力与智能体的乐观，这是一次立场深化。

views.en: Africa isn't behind in AI; it leapfrogged legacy gaps, and language models can revolutionize education in local languages.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而跨越了历史遗留问题；语言模型有望用本地语言革新非洲教育，最大障碍是研究者相信自己能申请顶尖机构。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
views.zh: 2020 年，他主张泛化到训练分布之外才是智能的关键缺口，靠无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索而非密集奖励来实现，并强调动态任务与跨机器人形态的零样本泛化。

views.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem, not just an algorithm problem; data sources and sample efficiency remain the bottleneck.
views.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：机器人本质上是数据问题，数据来源与样本效率始终是瓶颈，早期关注好奇心探索的样本效率，后期转向多源数据。

views.en: A general-purpose robot brain, pretrained on video and simulation then post-trained on real data, can span any form factor.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：一个通用机器人大脑，先在大规模视频与仿真上预训练、再用真实数据后训练，就能跨任意形态与任务，类比语言模型。

views.en: Deployment, not modeling, is the primary challenge; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous real-world testing.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确转向：部署而非建模才是首要挑战，机器人无法像软件那样快速扩张，必须经过严格的真实世界测试。

views.en: A data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments, though home-robot timelines stay uncertain.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出跨垂直领域的数据飞轮，推动从结构化到非结构化环境的 Scaling，同时承认家用机器人的中期时间线高度不确定。
